description_ar_detailed: هو وجود الذات الواجبة بذاتها، التي لا يسبقها عدم ولا يلحقها زوال، والغنية عن موجد يوجدها.
description_tr_detailed: Allah Teâlâ'nın var olması demektir. O'nun varlığı zatının gereğidir, yokluğu düşünülemez ve var olmak için bir yaratıcıya ihtiyacı yoktur.
description_en_detailed: The One whose existence is necessary, self-subsisting, and absolute, without beginning or end.

description_ar_detailed: هو عدم افتتاح وجوده سبحانه وتعالى، فهو الأول الذي ليس قبله شيء.
description_tr_detailed: Allah'ın varlığının başlangıcının olmaması, zaman kavramından münezzeh olarak her şeyden önce var olması demektir.
description_en_detailed: The One who is timeless and pre-eternal, having no beginning to His existence.

description_ar_detailed: هو استمرار الوجود في المستقبل من غير غاية ولا نهاية، فهو الآخر الذي ليس بعده شيء.
description_tr_detailed: Allah'ın varlığının sonunun olmaması, ebediyen var olması ve fani olmaktan tamamen münezzeh bulunmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: The One who is everlasting and immortal, whose existence has no end.

description_ar_detailed: وحدانية الله سبحانه في ذاته لا قسيم له، وفي صفاته لا شبيه له، وفي أفعاله لا شريك له.
description_tr_detailed: Allah'ın zatında, sıfatlarında ve fiillerinde bir ve tek olması, ortağının, benzerinin ve denginin bulunmamasıdır.
description_en_detailed: The One who is unique and singular in His essence, attributes, and actions, without any partner.

description_ar_detailed: تنزهه جل وعلا عن أن يشبه شيئاً من مخلوقاته أو يشبهه شيء منها في وجه من الوجوه.
description_tr_detailed: Allah'ın sonradan yaratılmış olan hiçbir varlığa, maddeye, şekle veya hayale hiçbir yönden benzememesi sıfatıdır.
description_en_detailed: The One who is completely distinct and dissimilar from everything He has created.

meaning_ar_short: الغنى المطلق عن كل ما سواه.
meaning_tr_short: Varlığı için hiçbir şeye muhtaç olmamak.
description_ar_detailed: قيامه سبحانه بذاته واستغناؤه عن المكان والمخصص، وحاجة كل ما سواه إليه.
description_tr_detailed: Allah'ın var olmak ve varlığını sürdürmek için bir mekāna, zamana veya herhangi bir yaratıcıya muhtaç olmaması, her şeyin O'na muhtaç olmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: The One who exists by Himself, absolutely independent of any place, time, or assistance.

description_ar_detailed: انفراده سبحانه بالملك والتدبير والعبادة فلا ند له ولا شريك في ملكه.
description_tr_detailed: Mülkünde, idaresinde, hükmünde ve ibadet edilmeye layık oluşunda hiçbir ortağının ve yardımcısının bulunmamasıdır.
description_en_detailed: The One who rules and governs the universe entirely alone, without any associate or co-ruler.

description_ar_detailed: أنه لا مثيل له في ذاته ولا في صفاته، ليس كمثله شيء وهو السميع البصير.
description_tr_detailed: Zat-ı Kibriya'sının ne dünyada ne de ahirette hiçbir benzerinin, emsalinin ve mukabilinin olmamasıdır.
description_en_detailed: The One who has absolutely no equivalent, counterpart, or equal in existence.

meaning_ar_short: تنزهه عن وجود منازع أو مضاد.
description_ar_detailed: ليس له سبحانه ضد ينازعه في سلطانه أو يضاد حكمه وأمره.
description_tr_detailed: Kendisine karşı koyacak, iradesini engelleyecek veya hükmünü iptal edecek hiçbir zıddının ve muhalifinin bulunmamasıdır.
description_en_detailed: The One who has no opponent or adversary capable of resisting His command.

description_ar_detailed: تنزه الذات الإلهية عن الأعضاء والأجزاء والأبعاد والتركيب الجسماني.
description_tr_detailed: Allah'ın en, boy, derinlik, ağırlık gibi cismani özelliklerden, parçalardan ve bir araya gelmekten uzak olmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: The One who is free from physical dimensions, parts, bodily form, or composition.

description_ar_detailed: تنزهه عن أن يكون جوهراً يشغل حيزاً من الفراغ أو يقبل الانقسام.
description_tr_detailed: Boşlukta yer kaplayan ve arazlara mahal olan temel madde/cevher niteliğinde olmaktan tamamen uzak olmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: The One who is free from being a spatial substance or matter that occupies a specific void.

description_ar_detailed: تنزهه عن الأعراض التي تطرأ على الأجسام كالألوان والطعوم والروائح والتغير.
description_tr_detailed: Renk, koku, tat gibi sonradan var olan, bir cevhere bağlı olarak değişen niteliklerden münezzeh olmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: The One who is free from temporary, transient qualities or characteristics inherent to created things.

description_ar_detailed: أنه سبحانه غني عن المكان، كان الله ولا مكان وهو الآن على ما عليه كان.
description_tr_detailed: Mekânı kendisi yarattığı için, herhangi bir yere veya mekâna yerleşmekten, sınırlandırılmaktan uzak olmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah is beyond place and is not contained, localized, or confined by space, for He is the Creator of place.

meaning_ar_short: تنزهه عن الجريان في الوقت والزمان.
description_ar_detailed: تنزهه عن مرور الأوقات وتتابع السنين، فالزمن من خلق الله ولا يجري عليه.
description_tr_detailed: Zaman akışının, geçmiş, şimdiki zaman ve geleceğin O'nun üzerinde cereyan etmemesi, zamanı yaratmış olmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: The One who created time and is not subject to sequence, duration, past, or future.

description_ar_detailed: تنزهه سبحانه عن أن تحيط به الجهات الست (فوق، تحت، يمين، شمال، أمام، خلف).
description_tr_detailed: Alt, üst, sağ, sol, ön, arka gibi altı yöne tabi olmaktan ve bir yönde bulunmaktan uzak olmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: The One who cannot be confined or pointed to within any physical direction.

description_ar_detailed: أنه سبحانه لا يحيط به حد ولا تضبطه مقادير ولا تحصره نهايات.
description_tr_detailed: Zatı ve azameti için herhangi bir bitiş noktası, ölçü, çerçeve veya sınır bulunmamasıdır.
description_en_detailed: The One whose essence and grandeur have no boundaries, limits, or dimensions.

description_ar_detailed: ليس لعظمته وقدرته وسائر صفاته غاية ينتهي إليها.
description_tr_detailed: O'nun kemalinin, azametinin, ilminin ve diğer tüm sıfatlarının bir tükeniş ve son noktası olmamasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah has no end, limit, or termination in His essence or attributes, while remaining utterly unlike created things.

description_ar_detailed: تنزهه عن الاستحالة والتحول من حال إلى حال، فهو الثابت الذي لا يتغير.
description_tr_detailed: Zatında ve sıfatlarında hiçbir şekilde başkalaşma, gelişme, gerileme, yaşlanma veya değişim olmamasıdır.
description_en_detailed: The One who is absolutely immutable, undergoing no transformation or alteration.

description_ar_detailed: تنزهه عن الانتقال من مكان إلى مكان لأن ذلك من صفات الأجسام المحتاجة.
description_tr_detailed: Bir yerden bir yere taşınmak, hareket etmek, gitmek ve gelmek gibi yaratılmışlık alametlerinden uzak olmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: The One who is free from shifting, movement, or traveling from one position to another.

meaning_tr_short: Bir şeye nüfuz etmekten/girmekten münezzeh olmak.
description_ar_detailed: بطلان حلوله سبحانه في شيء من خلقه أو امتزاجه بالمخلوقات.
description_tr_detailed: Allah'ın yarattığı şeylerin içine girmesi, onlarla birleşmesi veya bir bedene hulûl etmesi düşüncesinin reddidir.
description_en_detailed: The One who does not dwell inside any of His creation, entirely free from incarnation.

description_ar_detailed: استحالة أن يتحد سبحانه مع غيره ليصيرا شيئاً واحداً.
description_tr_detailed: Allah'ın başka bir varlıkla bir araya gelip tek bir vücut veya cevher oluşturmasının mutlak olarak imkansızlığıdır.
description_en_detailed: The One who cannot merge or unify with any entity to form a single substance.

description_ar_detailed: أنه سبحانه لا يحتاج إلى أحد في شيء، بل الكل مفتقر إليه غاية الافتقار.
description_tr_detailed: Yarattığı hiçbir mahluka, kulların ibadetine veya kainatın nizamına hiçbir açıdan ihtiyaç duymamasıdır.
description_en_detailed: The One who is completely self-sufficient and stands in no need of any creature or action.

description_ar_detailed: عدم سهوه أو ذهوله عن شيء في السماوات ولا في الأرض، محيط بكل شيء.
description_tr_detailed: Kainatta olup biten hiçbir şeyden habersiz kalmaması, dalgınlık ve dikkatsizlikten tamamen uzak olmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: The One who is never unmindful, inattentive, or heedless of any matter.

description_ar_detailed: كمال قدرته سبحانه بحيث لا يعجزه شيء في الأرض ولا في السماء.
description_tr_detailed: Dilediği her şeyi yapmaya gücünün yetmesi, hiçbir mahlukun O'nu aciz bırakamamasıdır.
description_en_detailed: The One whose omnipotence is absolute, never restricted by inability or weakness.

description_ar_detailed: كمال علمه المطلق فلا يخفى عليه مثقال ذرة، منزه عن الجهل والنسيان.
description_tr_detailed: Gerek gizli gerek açık, olmuş ve olacak her şeyi tam bir ilimle bilmesi, cehaletten uzak olmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: The One whose knowledge encompasses all realities, entirely untouched by ignorance.

description_ar_detailed: ثبوت الحياة الدائمة له وتنزهه عن الموت والفناء.
description_tr_detailed: Hayatının ezeli ve ebedi olması, yok oluşu andıran ölüm hadisesinden tamamen münezzeh bulunmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: The One who possesses eternal, absolute life and is utterly immune to death.

description_ar_detailed: استمرار وجوده وعدم تطرق الفناء أو الزوال إلى ذاته العلية.
description_tr_detailed: Bütün mahlukat fani olduktan sonra da varlığının zeval bulmadan kalması, yok oluşun O'na yaklaşamamasıdır.
description_en_detailed: The One whose existence is permanent, never subject to cessation or extinction.

description_ar_detailed: عدله التام وتنزهه عن أن يظلم أحداً من خلقه شيئاً، ولا يظلم ربك أحداً.
description_tr_detailed: Kullarına zerre kadar haksızlık ve zulüm yapmaması, her işinde mutlak adaletle hükmetmesidir.
description_en_detailed: The One who is perfectly just and entirely free from wrongdoing, injustice, or oppression.

meaning_ar_short: تنزهه عن الأفعال التي لا حكمة فيها.
description_ar_detailed: أفعاله كلها جارية على مقتضى الحكمة البالغة، منزه عن اللعب والعبث.
description_tr_detailed: Her yarattığı şeyde ve her hükmünde bir hikmet bulunması, anlamsız ve gayesiz işlerden uzak olmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: The One whose actions all carry profound wisdom, free from pointless or futile activities.

description_ar_detailed: ثبات علمه وإحاطته فلا يغيب عنه معلوم، وما كان ربك نسياً.
description_tr_detailed: Hiçbir bilgiyi, ameli veya mahluku unutmaması, ilminin her an eksiksiz olarak hazır olmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: The One whose perfect memory and knowledge are immutable, never forgetting anything.

description_ar_detailed: كمال قيوميته وسلطانه فلا يغشاه نوم ولا يحتاج إلى راحة.
description_tr_detailed: Kainatı her an diri olarak yönetmesi, uyku gibi canlılara has bir zaafiyetten uzak bulunmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: The One who maintains control over existence at all times, completely free from sleep.

description_ar_detailed: نفي النعاس وأوائل النوم عنه سبحانه، لا تأخذه سنة ولا نوم.
description_tr_detailed: Uykunun başlangıcı olan gaflet, gevşeme veya uyuklama hallerinden mutlak surette uzak olmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: The One who is completely free from even the slightest drowsiness or slumber.

meaning_ar_short: صفة أزلية توجب صحة الاتصاف بالعلم والقدرة.
description_ar_detailed: صفة قائمة بذاته تعالى مصححة لجميع صفات الإدراك، وهو الحي القيوم.
description_tr_detailed: Allah Teâlâ'nın diri olması demektir. O'nun hayatı mahlûkatın hayatına benzemez; ruh, beden, hareket ve değişim gibi yaratılmışlara ait özelliklere muhtaç değildir.
description_en_detailed: Allah is ever-living with a life befitting His majesty. His life does not resemble created life and is not dependent on body, soul, movement, or change.

description_ar_detailed: صفة أزلية تنكشف بها الأشياء كلها على ما هي عليه دون سبق خفاء أو جهل.
description_tr_detailed: Gizli, açık, geçmiş, gelecek, küçük, büyük her şeyi, kalplerden geçen niyetleri eksiksiz ve tam olarak bilmesidir.
description_en_detailed: The all-encompassing, pre-eternal attribute by which everything is completely unveiled to Him.

description_ar_detailed: صفة أزلية تتعلق بالموجودات المسموعة دون حاجة إلى أذن أو آلة.
description_tr_detailed: Sesli veya sessiz, fısıltı halinde veya açıkça söylenen her şeyi bir vasıtaya ihtiyaç duymadan işitmesidir.
description_en_detailed: The eternal attribute of hearing everything audible without any dependency on ears or soundwaves.

description_ar_detailed: صفة أزلية تنكشف بها المبصرات كلها انكشافاً تاماً دون حاجة إلى حدقة أو ضوء.
description_tr_detailed: Karanlıkta veya aydınlıkta, göz gibi bir organa ihtiyaç duymaksızın her mahluku ve hareketi eksiksiz görmesidir.
description_en_detailed: The eternal attribute of sight by which every visible entity is perfectly manifest to Him.

meaning_ar_short: صفة تخصيص الممكن ببعض ما يجوز عليه.
description_ar_detailed: صفة أزلية توجب تخصيص الممكنات ببعض ما يجوز عليها من الأوقات والجهات والصفات.
description_tr_detailed: Bir şeyin var olup olmamasını, zamanını, şeklini ve niteliklerini dilediği gibi belirleme yetkinliğidir.
description_en_detailed: The eternal attribute by which God chooses and specifies the timing, nature, and existence of choices.

description_ar_detailed: صفة أزلية يتأتى بها إيجاد الممكن وإعدامه على وفق الإرادة والعلم.
description_tr_detailed: Dilediği her şeyi yaratmaya, yok etmeye, evreni sevk ve idare etmeye tam ve noksansız bir güce sahip olmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: The absolute, eternal strength and power to bring things into existence or reduce them to nothingness.

meaning_ar_short: صفة أزلية يعبر عنها بالكتب والخطاب.
description_ar_detailed: صفة أزلية قائمة بذاته تعالى منزهة عن الحروف والأصوات، يعبر عنها بالكتب المنزلة.
description_tr_detailed: Ses, harf ve dil gibi beşeri vasıtalara ihtiyaç duymadan vahiy göndermesi, peygamberleriyle konuşması ve kitaplar indirmesidir.
description_en_detailed: The eternal attribute of speech, independent of alphabet, voice, or language, communicated through scriptures.

meaning_ar_short: صفة إخراج الممكن من العدم إلى الوجود.
description_ar_detailed: صفة أزلية حقيقية عند الماتوريدية بها يخرج الله المخلوقات من العدم إلى الوجود.
description_tr_detailed: Kainattaki her şeyi kudret ve iradesiyle yoktan var etmesi, biçimlendirmesi ve rızıklandırması fiillerinin kaynağı olan sıfattır.
description_en_detailed: Allah is described by creation / Genesis, in a perfect, eternal manner befitting His majesty and unlike created beings.

description_ar_detailed: الوصف المعنوي الملازم لذات الله تعالى بكونه حياً حياة تليق بجلاله.
description_tr_detailed: Hayat sıfatıyla nitelenmiş olmanın bir sonucu olarak, Allah Teâlâ'nın ebedi olarak 'Diri olması' halidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah is Hayy, the Ever-Living. This denotes His being eternally alive with a life that befits His majesty and is unlike the life of created beings.

description_ar_detailed: الوصف المعنوي القائم بالذات المشتق من صفة العلم، المحيط بكل معلوم.
description_tr_detailed: İlim sıfatına sahip olmanın sonucu olarak, Allah'ın her şeyi eksiksiz bilen konumunda bulunmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: The state of being all-knowing, completely conscious of realities.

description_ar_detailed: الوصف المعنوي التابع لصفة السمع، الذي يقتضي إدراك كل صوت خفي أو جلي.
description_tr_detailed: Sem' sıfatının sonucu olarak, her sesin ve fısıltının Allah tarafından tam olarak işitilmesi halidir.
description_en_detailed: The state of being receptive and listening to all audible phenomena.

description_ar_detailed: الوصف المعنوي التابع لصفة البصر، المحيط بكل مرئي ومبصر.
description_tr_detailed: Basar sıfatının tecellisi olarak, kainattaki her zerratın Allah'ın nazarında sürekli görülüyor olmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: The state of being watchful and seeing all hidden or manifest things.

description_ar_detailed: حاله تعالى بكونه مريداً يختار ما يشاء ويحكم ما يريد وفق حكمته.
description_tr_detailed: İrade sıfatının bir vasfı olarak, her şeyin ancak O'nun seçimi ve dilemesiyle meydana gelmesi durumudur.
description_en_detailed: The state of being the ultimate chooser who executes choices based on wisdom.

description_ar_detailed: الوصف المعنوي الدال على تمكن الذات من التصرف المطلق بالإيجاد والإعدام.
description_tr_detailed: Kudret sıfatının tecellisiyle, her bir mahluk üzerinde mutlak tasarruf ve yaptırım gücüne sahip olma halidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah is Kadîr, the One fully described with power. He has absolute ability over all possible things, in a manner befitting His majesty.

description_ar_detailed: الوصف المعنوي الدال على توجيه الكلام الإلهي إلى العباد بالرسالات.
description_tr_detailed: Kelâm sıfatına haiz olarak kullarına hitap eden, emir ve nehiyler bildiren konuşucu vasfıdır.
description_en_detailed: The state of being the speaker who guides creation through signs and books.

description_ar_detailed: حاله سبحانه بكونه الخالق الفعلي المحدث لكل ما في الكون.
description_tr_detailed: Tekvîn sıfatının aktif olarak yürütülmesiyle, maddeleri ve alemleri meydana getiren var edici vasfıdır.
description_en_detailed: The status of being the active producer and designer of the created world.

description_ar_detailed: صنع الشيء وإيجاده على غير مثال سابق بتقدير محكم.
description_tr_detailed: Herhangi bir örnek ve madde bulunmaksızın, bir şeyi kendi takdiriyle doğrudan var etmesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah creates and brings things into existence from nonexistence according to His knowledge, will, power, and wisdom.

meaning_ar_short: إخراج الشيء من حيز العدم إلى الوجود.
description_ar_detailed: جعل الشيء موجوداً حقيقة بعد أن كان عدماً محضاً.
description_tr_detailed: Kudret taallukuyla bir varlığı görünür kılmak, yokluk karanlığından çıkarıp var etmek fiilidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah brings what He wills from nonexistence into actual existence by His power and decree.

meaning_ar_short: خلق الشيء على غير مثال يحتذى.
description_ar_detailed: إنشاء المخلوقات وإتقانها بغاية الحسن والجمال دون تقليد أو نمط سابق.
description_tr_detailed: Kainatı daha önce hiç görülmemiş, taklit edilmemiş muazzam bir güzellik ve sanatta, benzersiz kılma fiilidir.
description_en_detailed: The production of masterpieces without prior blueprint or imitation.

description_ar_detailed: ترتيب خلق الشيء وتنميته حتى يبلغ كماله المقصود.
description_tr_detailed: Varlıkları parça parça bir araya getirerek düzenli bir biçimde inşa etmesi ve olgunlaştırmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: This refers to Allah's act of bringing created things into ordered existence and developing them according to His wisdom and decree.

description_ar_detailed: بث الروح في الأجساد وإعطاء ميزة الحياة والنماء للمخلوق.
description_tr_detailed: Cansız maddelere ruh üfleyerek canlandırmak, bitkileri diriltmek, ahirette insanları yeniden hayata döndürmek fiilidir.
description_en_detailed: The divine intervention that introduces or restores life to structures.

description_ar_detailed: قبض الأرواح وإنهاء الآجال المقدرة للمخلوقات في الدنيا.
description_tr_detailed: Eceli gelen canlıların ruhunu kabzederek bu dünyadaki biyolojik ve hayati varlıklarına son vermesidir.
description_en_detailed: The termination of physical life by withdrawing the vital spirit.

description_ar_detailed: إخراج العباد من قبورهم أحياء للحساب والجزاء بعد فناء الدنيا.
description_tr_detailed: Kıyamet koptuktan sonra, hesap verilmesi amacıyla tüm insanların kabirlerinden kaldırılarak yeniden canlandırılmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah will resurrect the dead and bring them forth for reckoning and recompense by His perfect power.

description_ar_detailed: سوق الخلائق جميعاً وجمعهم في موقف القيامة لفصل القضاء.
description_tr_detailed: Yeniden diriltilen mahlukatın, büyük hesap meydanı olan mahşer yerinde bir araya getirilip sevk edilmesidir.
description_en_detailed: The gathering of all generation lines together into the vast fields of judgment.

description_ar_detailed: نشر الكتب وصحف الأعمال وتوزيعها على العباد آخذ بيمينه وآخذ بشماله.
description_tr_detailed: Ölümden sonra yaratılmışları yeniden diriltip ortaya çıkarması ve onları hesap için sevk etmesiyle ilgili ilâhî fiildir.
description_en_detailed: This refers to Allah's bringing the dead forth after death and spreading creation out for reckoning, according to His perfect power and justice.

description_ar_detailed: إيصال ما به بقاء الأجساد والنفوس من النعم والأقوات إلى مستحقيها.
description_tr_detailed: Canlıların maddi ve manevi tüm ihtiyaçlarını, gıdalarını, varlıklarını devam ettirecek unsurları ikram etmesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah grants provision to His creatures and delivers to each what sustains it according to His wisdom.

description_ar_detailed: التفضل بوجوه الخيرات والمنافع التي تلائم العيش وتسعد النفس.
description_tr_detailed: Kullarına karşılıksız olarak faydalanacakları hayırlar, sağlık, sıhhat ve güzellikler bahşetmesidir.
description_en_detailed: The provision of positive advantages, grants, and life-enhancing tools.

meaning_ar_short: التفضل بما لا يجب وتقديم الخير.
description_ar_detailed: مضاعفة الأجر وإعطاء العطايا الجميلة تفضلاً وكرماً وإحساناً.
description_tr_detailed: Kullarına hak ettiklerinden çok daha fazlasını iyilik ve lutuf olarak sunması, her işi en güzel surette icra etmesidir.
description_en_detailed: The absolute implementation of optimal benevolence far exceeding basic dues.

description_ar_detailed: إيصال المنافع والملاطفة للعبد من حيث لا يحتسب ولا يشعر.
description_tr_detailed: Kulun hiç fark edemeyeceği gizli ve latif yollarla onun iyiliğini gözetmesi, işlerini kolaylaştırmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah shows subtle kindness to His servants, bringing benefit and protection through ways they may not perceive.

meaning_ar_short: إرادة الخير وإفاضة النعم على المحتاج.
description_ar_detailed: رأفته سبحانه بعباده وشفقته المحيطة بكل شيء إيجاداً وإمداداً.
description_tr_detailed: Mahlukatın tamamını kucaklayan geniş bir şefkatle acıları dindirmesi, rızıklandırması ve bağışlamasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah has mercy upon creation, bestowing care, provision, forgiveness, and compassion in a manner befitting His majesty.

description_ar_detailed: ستر ذنوب العباد بفضله وعدم مؤاخذتهم بها صيانة لهم.
description_tr_detailed: Kulların kusurlarını ve suçlarını örterek onlara azap etmekten vazgeçmesi, günah kirlerini silmesidir.
description_en_detailed: The wiping away and screening of flaws, guarding accounts from severe friction.

description_ar_detailed: إزالة أثر الجناية ومحوها من الأصل تكرماً وتحبباً.
description_tr_detailed: Günahın cezasını kaldırmakla kalmayıp, amel defterindeki izini de tamamen silerek hiç işlenmemiş gibi muamele etmesidir.
description_en_detailed: The absolute deletion of errors, making them entirely nonexistent in evaluation.

meaning_ar_short: الرجوع بالعبد إلى المغفرة بعد الندم.
description_ar_detailed: تيسير أسباب الإنابة للعبد وقبول ندمه ورجوعه إلى الطاعة.
description_tr_detailed: Hatasından dönüp samimiyetle kendisine sığınan kulun yönelişine rıza ile karşılık verip onu affetmesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah accepts the sincere repentance of His servants, forgives them, and turns them back toward obedience and mercy.

description_ar_detailed: إرشاد الخلق إلى ما فيه صلاحهم وفلاحهم في المعاش والمعاد.
description_tr_detailed: Kulun kalbini imana, hayra ve cennete giden dosdoğru İslam yoluna açması ve kılavuzluk etmesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah guides whom He wills to truth, faith, righteousness, and the path leading to His pleasure.

description_ar_detailed: منع التوفيق عن العبد خذلاناً له بسبب إصراره على غيه وعناده.
description_tr_detailed: Kendi özgür iradesiyle küfrü ve azgınlığı seçen inkârcıların kalbini tercihlerine paralel olarak hidayetten mahrum etmesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah leaves astray those who knowingly choose falsehood and persist in rejection, withholding guidance by His justice and wisdom.

meaning_ar_short: جعل أفعال العبد موافقة لما يحبه الله.
description_ar_detailed: خلق القدرة على الطاعة وتسهيل سبل الخير والرضا للعبد.
description_tr_detailed: Kulun hayırlı niyetleri doğrultusunda işlerini kolaylaştırması, ona hayır işlemeye güç ve imkan vermesidir.
description_en_detailed: The synchronization of external opportbeingies with internal pure intentions to maximize goodness.

meaning_ar_short: ترك العبد ونفسه وحرمانه من المعونة.
description_ar_detailed: وكول العبد إلى حوله وقوته الضعيفة عقوبة له على إعراضه.
description_tr_detailed: Haddini aşan ve isyanda direten kuldan yardım ve inayet desteğini çekerek onu nefsinin eline terk etmesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah may withdraw special aid from those who turn away arrogantly, leaving them to the weakness of their own choices.

description_ar_detailed: تقويم الفساد وتدبير الأمور بما يحقق الخير والانسجام للمكلفين.
description_tr_detailed: Kulların hallerini, kalplerini, ahlaklarını ve yeryüzündeki düzeni salaha kavuşturup fesadı ortadan kaldırmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah rectifies hearts, deeds, communities, and affairs, removing corruption by His wisdom and mercy.

meaning_ar_short: إبطال عمل المفسدين ومجازاتهم على فسادهم.
meaning_tr_short: Fesat çıkaranların işlerini boşa çıkarmak ve onları cezalandırmak.
description_ar_detailed: إبطال أعمال المفسدين ومجازاتهم بعدله على بغيهم وفسادهم، لا بمعنى نسبة الفساد إليه سبحانه.
description_tr_detailed: Allah’ın fesadı sevmediğini, bozguncuların işlerini boşa çıkarıp onları adalet ve hikmetiyle cezalandırdığını ifade eder. Bu, Allah’a bozgunculuk isnadı değil; bozgunculara karşı ilâhî hüküm ve cezadır.
description_en_detailed: This refers to Allah's nullifying the work of corrupters and punishing corruption with justice and wisdom. It does not attribute corruption to Allah; rather, it affirms His judgment against it.

description_ar_detailed: رفع شأن من يطيعه وإلقاء المهابة والنصر له في قلوب الخلق.
description_tr_detailed: Dilediği kulunu veya topluluğu haysiyet, makam, zafer ve şerefle donatarak galip ve üstün kılmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah grants honor, dignity, strength, and victory to whom He wills, according to His wisdom and justice.

description_ar_detailed: وضع شأن المتكبرين والمفسدين وحرمانهم من القوة والمنعة.
description_tr_detailed: Zalimleri, müstekbirleri ve isyankarları makamlarından indirip halkın gözünde küçük düşürerek perişan etmesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah abases and humbles whom He wills by His justice, especially those who persist in arrogance and wrongdoing.

description_ar_detailed: رفع أقدار الأولياء والعلماء في الدنيا والآخرة وإعلاء شأنهم.
description_tr_detailed: Müminlerin manevi derecelerini, salih amellerini ve gökleri yücelere doğru yükseltip kaldırması fiilidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah raises in rank, honor, knowledge, or nearness whom He wills by His grace and wisdom.

description_ar_detailed: خفْض الكافرين والمستكبرين وإحباط منزلتهم الخادعة.
description_tr_detailed: Müşriklerin, kibirlenenlerin şanını, değerini sıfırlayıp onları esfeli safiline doğru indirmesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah lowers whom He wills by His justice, especially those who persist in arrogance, disbelief, and oppression.

description_ar_detailed: حبس النعم عن بعض العباد لحكمة، أو جمع القوة وحبسها.
description_tr_detailed: Bir hikmete binaen rızkı daraltması, kalpleri hüzünle sıkıştırması veya ecel anında ruhları çekip almasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah constricts provision, hearts, or affairs, and He takes souls at their appointed time, all according to His wisdom.

description_ar_detailed: إفاضة النعم وتوسعتها على من يشاء كرماً وجوداً رحيباً.
description_tr_detailed: Rızıkları bollaştırması, kalplere inşirah ve ferahlık vermesi, nimetlerini cömertçe sermesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah expands provision, hearts, mercy, and relief according to His wisdom and generosity.

description_ar_detailed: كف العطايا وعوائق البلاء حكمة ومصلحة يعلمها سبحانه.
description_tr_detailed: Kullarını korumak için zarar verecek şeylerin önünü kapatması veya layık olmayanlardan nimeti esirgemesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah withholds what He wills and prevents what He wills, either as mercy, protection, trial, or justice, all according to His perfect wisdom.

description_ar_detailed: إعطاء العباد سؤلهم وما ينفعهم بغير حساب ولا منّ.
description_tr_detailed: Geniş ve hudutsuz lütfundan kullarına karşılık beklemeksizin büyük nimetler ikram etmesi fiilidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah grants gifts and blessings from His bounty without need, compulsion, or expectation of return.

description_ar_detailed: سوق المقادير والعطايا النافعة إلى مستحقيها من البرية.
description_tr_detailed: Her bir varlığa ihtiyacı olan uzuvları, yetenekleri ve imkanları bizzat takdir edip ulaştırmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah gives and assigns blessings, abilities, provision, and means to His creatures according to His knowledge and decree.

description_ar_detailed: حبس السماء أن تقع على الأرض وحفظ السماوات أن تزولا.
description_tr_detailed: Göklerin düşmesini, yağmurların yağmasını veya nimetlerin akışını kendi iradesiyle durdurup tutmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah holds back what He wills, preserving the heavens and the earth and withholding blessings or trials by His wisdom.

description_ar_detailed: بعث الأنبياء مبشرين ومنذرين وإرسال آيات الهدى والرحمة.
description_tr_detailed: İnsanları uyarmak üzere peygamberler göndermesi veya bulutları süren rüzgarları irsal etmesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah sends messengers, signs, winds, rain, mercy, and commands as He wills for guidance, provision, and trial.

meaning_ar_short: تنزيل الكتب أو المطر من السماء.
description_ar_detailed: إيصال الكتب السماوية إلى الرسل، وإيصال الأمطار إلى الأرض.
description_tr_detailed: Kutsal kitapları, vahyi veya gökten bereketi (yağmuru) yukarıdan aşağıya doğru indirmesi fiilidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah sends down revelation, rain, mercy, and blessings according to His wisdom and decree.

description_ar_detailed: إنزال القرآن مفرقاً منجماً على قلب النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم حكمة تبياناً.
description_tr_detailed: Kur'an-ı Kerim gibi vahiyleri bir kerede değil, olayların akışına göre aşama aşama, sindire sindire indirmesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah revealed the Qur'an gradually with wisdom, guidance, clarification, and mercy for His servants.

description_ar_detailed: خطاب الله تعالى لأوليائه وأنبيائه بطرق خفية معجزة لإبلاغ شرعه.
description_tr_detailed: Peygamberlerinin kalplerine emirlerini, yasaklarını ve gayb bilgilerini süratli ve gizli bir yolla bildirmesidir.
description_en_detailed: The act by which Allah conveys His command, guidance, and unseen knowledge to His prophets in a manner known to Him.

description_ar_detailed: أمر العباد ونهيهم بما يترتب عليه الثواب والعقاب امتحاناً لضمائرهم.
description_tr_detailed: Akıl sağlığı yerinde ve ergenlik çağına gelmiş kullarını ibadet ve haramlardan kaçınmakla yükümlü kılmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah makes morally responsible servants accountable through commands and prohibitions, establishing reward and punishment with justice.

description_ar_detailed: طلب إيجاد الفعل من المكلفين رعاية لمصالحهم في الدارين.
description_tr_detailed: Kullarının faydasına olan namaz, adalet, doğruluk gibi amellerin yapılmasını kesin olarak buyurmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah commands what is good, just, and beneficial, and His command is based on perfect knowledge and wisdom.

description_ar_detailed: طلب الكف عن المفاسد والشرور لحماية النفس والتربية الإيمانية.
description_tr_detailed: Zulüm, zina, hırsızlık gibi ruha ve topluma zarar veren çirkin amellerin yapılmamasını emretmesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah prohibits what is harmful, unjust, corrupting, or sinful, protecting His servants through His law.

description_ar_detailed: خلق الأمور وإنفاذها مطابقة لعلم الله وإرادته السابقة.
description_tr_detailed: Ezeli ilimde takdir edilen olayların zamanı gelince aynen yaratılıp uygulamaya konması fiilidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah brings His eternal decree into occurrence at its appointed time with perfect knowledge and power.

description_ar_detailed: تحديد مقادير الأشياء وصفاتها وأوقاتها قبل حدوثها حكمة بالغة.
description_tr_detailed: Kainatta olacak her şeyin miktarını, zamanını ve şeklini ezelde tam bir ölçü ile planlayıp belirlemesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah has determined all things with measure, time, order, and wisdom before their occurrence.

meaning_ar_short: تنظيم أمور الخلق على وفق العواقب.
description_ar_detailed: سوق الكائنات إلى غاياتها المحمودة وحفظ توازن الوجود إتقاناً.
description_tr_detailed: Kainattaki muazzam nizamın bozulmadan yürümesi için her şeyi tam bir uyum ve düzen içinde idare etmesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah governs and orders the affairs of creation, directing all things toward the ends decreed by His wisdom.

description_ar_detailed: صياغة المخلوق بمقادير دقيقة تناسب وظيفته في الحياة.
description_tr_detailed: Her bir mahlukun rızkını, ömrünü, boyunu ve kabiliyetlerini ince ayarlarla taksim edip şekillendirmesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah determines the measure, timing, form, and qualities of created things with precise wisdom.

meaning_tr_short: Dilediği gibi idare etmek, yön vermek.
description_ar_detailed: تصريف شؤون الممالك والخلائق وتقليب الأحوال عزة وحكمة.
description_tr_detailed: Mülkün yegane sahibi olarak, kâinat çarklarını, atomları ve galaksileri hiçbir engel olmaksızın evirip çevirmesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah has absolute authority over His dominion. He disposes of all affairs without partner, need, injustice, or deficiency.

description_ar_detailed: إلزام العباد بالشرائع والقوانين العادلة والبت في خصوماتهم.
description_tr_detailed: Yaratıkları arasında adaleti tesis etmek, helalleri-haramları koymak ve ahirette son kararı ilan etmek fiilidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah judges, legislates, and decides with truth and justice; none can overturn His judgment.

description_ar_detailed: إحصاء حركات المكلفين ومجازاتهم عليها بالعدل يوم العرض.
description_tr_detailed: İnsanların dünya hayatında zerre kadar yaptıkları iyilik ve kötülükleri adalet terazisinde ince ince hesap etmesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah will call His servants to account for their deeds with perfect knowledge, justice, and mercy.

description_ar_detailed: إعطاء الأجر الجزيل والرضوان لمن اتقى وأصلح تفضلاً ورحمة.
description_tr_detailed: Kendisine itaat eden, emirlerini tutan mümin kullarına kat kat fazlasıyla iyilik, ecir ve cennet ihsan etmesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah rewards obedience and righteous deeds by His grace, multiplying good far beyond what servants deserve.

description_ar_detailed: إنزال العقوبة بمستحقيها من الكافرين والمجرمين جزاء وفاقاً.
description_tr_detailed: Haddini aşan, isyan ve zulümde direten suçluları adaleti uyarınca hak ettikleri azap ile cezalandırmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah punishes wrongdoing with justice when His wisdom decrees, without injustice or excess.

description_ar_detailed: إنفاذ الوعيد الشديد فيمن عاند الحق واستكبر عن عبادة ربه.
description_tr_detailed: Cehennem ehline, işledikleri küfür ve zulümlerin bedeli olarak şiddetli sıkıntılar ve cezalar yaşatması fiilidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah may punish those who persist in disbelief and oppression, as a manifestation of His justice.

description_ar_detailed: قهر الجبابرة بإنزال بأس الله الذي لا يرد عن القوم المجرمين.
description_tr_detailed: Mazlumların hakkını korumak için, azgınlaşan ve peygamberleri yalanlayan zalimlerin güçlerini kırıp onları cezalandırmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah takes retribution from tyrants and wrongdoers, defending truth and the oppressed by His justice.

description_ar_detailed: تأييد عباده الصالحين وإعلاء كلمتهم وتمكينهم في الأرض.
description_tr_detailed: Zor durumda kalan mümin kullarına, ordularına beklenmedik fetihler ve yardımlar göndererek düşmanlarına karşı üstün getirmesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah grants help and victory to whom He wills, supporting truth and protecting His believing servants.

description_ar_detailed: إرسال السكينة والمدد للمؤمنين في مواطن الشدة والثبات.
description_tr_detailed: Müminlerin kalplerine sebat, cesaret ve meleklerle görünmez destekler sunarak onları koruması fiilidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah supports His believing servants with help, firmness, and unseen aid whenever He wills and in the way His wisdom decrees.

description_ar_detailed: فتح مملكته بالنصر للحق، وفتح القلوب بالمعرفة والإيمان.
description_tr_detailed: Maddi ve manevi kilitli kapıları, beldeleri müminlere açması; kalplere ilim ve marifet kapılarını aralamasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah opens the ways of victory, relief, knowledge, and guidance for whom He wills.

description_ar_detailed: إدامة النعم على العاصي ليزداد إثماً حتى يؤخذ بغتة وهو غافل.
description_tr_detailed: Kafirlerin ve günahkarların isyanı arttıkça onlara maddi nimetleri daha çok vererek, farkında olmadan helaklerine zemin hazırlamasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah may grant worldly ease to those who persist in rebellion, allowing them to proceed gradually toward the consequence they have chosen.

description_ar_detailed: تأخير العقاب عن الكافر لتقوم الحجة عليه كاملة.
description_tr_detailed: Zalimlere pişman olmaları veya günahlarının büsbütün artması için mühlet vermesi, cezalarını ertelemesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah grants respite and delays punishment by His wisdom, allowing repentance or establishing proof.

description_ar_detailed: تدبير الخفاء بما يبطل كيد الفجار ويجعل تدميرهم في تدبيرهم.
description_tr_detailed: İslam düşmanlarının sinsi planlarını, gizli tuzaklarını kendi başlarına geçirecek üstün ve adil planlar yapmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah knows the hidden plots of wrongdoers and turns their schemes back upon them with perfect knowledge, justice, and wisdom.

meaning_ar_short: جازاة الماكرين من حيث لا يشعرون.
description_ar_detailed: استدراج الماكرين وإيقاعهم في مغبة سوء أفعالهم خفية.
description_tr_detailed: Kötülük peşinde koşanların kurdukları hileleri hiç ummadıkları yollarla akamete uğratıp kendilerini cezalandırmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: When deceitful people plot against truth, Allah counters their plotting in a manner befitting His majesty, without injustice or likeness to created deceit.

description_ar_detailed: جعل عاقبة سخريتهم خسراناً وحسرة تذل رقابهم.
description_tr_detailed: Dini ve müminleri alaya alan münafıkların bu çirkin amellerine karşılık, onları dünyada ve ahirette rezil duruma düşürmesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah repays the mockery of hypocrites and wrongdoers by exposing and disgracing them with justice.

description_ar_detailed: تأجيل العقوبة المقدرة حكمة وإمهالاً للعباد.
description_tr_detailed: İsyankarlara hemen azap etmeyip, tövbe etmeleri veya inkarlarında olgunlaşmaları için süre tanımasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah may delay punishment and grant time, either to open the door of repentance or to establish the proof fully against the wrongdoer.

description_ar_detailed: كفالة أرزاق البرية كلها، وما من دابة في الأرض إلا على الله رزقها.
description_tr_detailed: Yeryüzündeki tek bir canlıyı unutmadan, her birinin rızkını tam vaktinde ve münasip şekilde dağıtmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah continually provides for all living beings, giving each its appointed share without neglect or forgetfulness.

description_ar_detailed: حفظ العباد بحراسته الكبرى من كيد الشيطان وشرور الحوادث.
description_tr_detailed: Kullarına acıyarak onları semavi ve arazi felaketlerden, şerli odakların saldırılarından koruyup gözetmesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah protects whom He wills from harms, enemies, trials, and dangers, outwardly and inwardly.

description_ar_detailed: كلاءة الله لخلقه وعنايته التامة بهم في حركاتهم وسكناتهم.
description_tr_detailed: Kainatın işleyişini ve kullarının durumlarını her an kontrolü altında tutup, onları bakımsız ve başıboş bırakmamasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah watches over and cares for creation, never leaving His servants neglected or beyond His knowledge.

meaning_ar_short: إبقاء الوجود على نظامه ومنع تلفه.
description_ar_detailed: حفظ السماوات والأرض أن تزولا، وحفظ أعمال العباد من الضياع.
description_tr_detailed: Gökleri ve yeri düzen içinde tutması, amelleri kaydetmesi ve kainat dengesini kıyamete dek korumasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah preserves creation, protects what He wills, and keeps every deed recorded without loss.

description_ar_detailed: نصرة الله لعباده المؤمنين، الله ولي الذين آمنوا يخرجهم من الظلمات إلى النور.
description_tr_detailed: Müminlerin hamisi, işlerini üzerine alan yöneticisi ve onları karanlıklardan aydınlığa çıkaran en yakın dostu olmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah takes the believers under His patronage, supporting, guiding, protecting, and drawing them near.

meaning_en_short: The Taking of a Chosen Servant as Intimate
description_ar_detailed: اصطفاء الرسل والأولياء بالتقريب الخصيص، واتخذ الله إبراهيم خليلاً.
description_tr_detailed: Hz. İbrahim'i halil (dost) edinmesi gibi, ihlaslı kullarını kendisine özel yakınlık derecelerine seçmesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah chooses and draws near whomever He wills from among His righteous servants, as He honored Ibrâhîm by taking him as a close friend, in a manner befitting His majesty.

meaning_ar_short: معاداة من عادى الله ورسله وأولياءه.
meaning_tr_short: Allah’a ve hak dine düşmanlık edenleri cezalandırmak.
description_ar_detailed: مجازاة من عادى الله ورسله وأولياءه، وإبطال كيده وظلمه بعدل الله وحكمته.
description_tr_detailed: Allah’ın dinine, peygamberlerine ve veli kullarına düşmanlık eden zalimleri rahmetinden uzaklaştırıp adaletiyle cezalandırmasıdır. Bu ifade beşerî kin anlamında değil, ilâhî adalet ve gazabın tecellisi olarak anlaşılır.
description_en_detailed: Allah opposes those who knowingly oppose His truth, His messengers, and His righteous servants. This is understood as divine justice and wrath, not as a human-like passion.

meaning_en_short: The Loving of His Righteous Servants
description_ar_detailed: رضوانه سبحانه عن المطيعين وتقريبهم إعزازاً لهم، يحبهم ويحبونه.
description_tr_detailed: Muttakileri, muhsinleri, sabredenleri övmesi, onlara yaklaşması ve kalplerine kendi muhabbetini yerleştirmesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah loves the righteous, the repentant, the patient, and those who do good, with a love befitting His majesty and unlike created emotion.

description_ar_detailed: تنزهه عن الرضا بأفعال الفجار وبغضها عقوبة لهم، كبر مقتاً عند الله.
description_tr_detailed: Kötülüğü, hainliği, ikiyüzlülüğü seçenlerin çirkin fiillerini sevmeyip onları rahmetinden uzaklaştırmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah detests disbelief, hypocrisy, injustice, and corruption. This is affirmed in a manner befitting His majesty, without resemblance to created aversion.

description_ar_detailed: صفة فعلية تظهر بإكرام العبد الطائع، رضي الله عنهم ورضوا عنه.
description_tr_detailed: Halis niyetle yapılan ibadet ve itaatleri kabul buyurup kulunu ebedi cennet mükafatına layık görmesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah is pleased with sincere faith, obedience, and righteous deeds. His pleasure is a true divine attribute befitting His majesty, unlike created feelings.

description_ar_detailed: انتقامه سبحانه من الكافرين والظالمين وسلب النعم منهم.
description_tr_detailed: Allah’ın zulüm, inkâr ve isyanda ısrar edenlere yönelik gazabının ve cezalandırma iradesinin tecellisidir. Bu, beşerî öfke ve duygusal taşkınlık anlamında değildir.
description_en_detailed: Allah's wrath is affirmed as befits His majesty against persistent disbelief, injustice, and rebellion. It is not a human-like emotion or agitation.

description_ar_detailed: إبعاد الكافرين والمفسدين عن مظان الغفران واللطف الإلهي.
description_tr_detailed: Şeytanı, zalimleri ve yalancıları ebedi şefkat ve merhamet dairesinin dışına atarak lanetlemesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah expels from His mercy those who persist in grave disbelief, falsehood, and injustice after proof is established.

description_ar_detailed: إعطاء السائلين مرادهم وتحقيق رجاء المتضرعين، ادعوني أستجب لكم.
description_tr_detailed: Kendisine el açıp yalvaran aciz kullarının seslerini duyup isteklerine kendi hikmetine göre en güzel cevabı vermesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah hears the supplications of His servants and answers them in the way that accords with His mercy, wisdom, knowledge, and decree.

description_ar_detailed: إحاطته بالعبد وإجابته له، ونحن أقرب إليه من حبل الوريد.
description_tr_detailed: Mekândan münezzeh olarak, ilmiyle, yardımıyla kuluna her şeyden daha yakın olması, kalbinden geçenleri bilmesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah is near to His servants through His knowledge, hearing, seeing, mercy, and response, without being confined by place or direction.

description_ar_detailed: تأييده للأولياء، لا تحزن إن الله معنا، إن الله مع الذين اتقوا.
description_tr_detailed: Özellikle sabreden ve takva sahibi kullarını korumasıyla, muhafazasıyla her an desteklemesi fiilidir.
description_en_detailed: The specialized alignment of divine grace to accompany and uphold righteous actors.

description_ar_detailed: إظهار آثار قدرته وأسمائه وصفاته في خلقه وقلوب عباده بما يشاء، من غير حلول ولا اتحاد.
description_tr_detailed: Allah’ın kudret, azamet, rahmet ve hikmetinin yaratılmışlar üzerinde kendisine yaraşan şekilde görünür kılınmasıdır. Bu ifade hulûl, birleşme veya yaratılmışlara benzemek anlamına gelmez.
description_en_detailed: This refers to the manifestation of Allah's power, majesty, mercy, and wisdom upon creation in a manner befitting Him, without indwelling, union, or resemblance to creation.

description_ar_detailed: تفضله بإخفاء المعاصي والقبائح عن أعين الناس ستراً لكرامته.
description_tr_detailed: Kulların işledikleri günahları ve çirkinlikleri başkalarından gizleyerek onların toplum içinde mahcup olmalarını engellemesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah veils the faults of His servants in this world and protects them from exposure by His mercy.

description_ar_detailed: إزالة الضر والكرب عن المكروبين، وكشف الحجب عن قلوب العارفين.
description_tr_detailed: Kulun üzerindeki ağır bela ve dert perdelerini kaldırması, sadık kulların kalbine hakikatleri ilham etmesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah removes distress, hardship, and veils from whom He wills, granting relief and insight by His mercy.

description_ar_detailed: منح العافية للمريض وإذهاب العلل والآلام ببركة اسمه الشافي.
description_tr_detailed: Maddi ve manevi hastalıklara yakalanan kullarının bedenlerine ve ruhlarına selamet, sağlık, afiyet vermesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah grants healing to bodies and hearts, removing illness and hardship by His mercy and decree.

description_ar_detailed: إنزال الشدائد على العباد لا لإهلاكهم بل لاختبار صبرهم ودينهم.
description_tr_detailed: Kulun sabrını, sadakatini ölçmek veya günahlarını temizlemek için ona hastalık, kıtlık ve zorluklar takdir etmesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah tests His servants through hardship, illness, loss, or fear in order to purify, discipline, or raise them.

description_ar_detailed: تقليب العباد بين النعمة والنقمة ليظهر الصادق من الكاذب.
description_tr_detailed: Dünya hayatını bir imtihan sahnesi kılarak, kimin daha güzel amel işleyeceğini ortaya çıkarmak için kulunu çeşitli şartlara tabi tutmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah tests His servants with good and hardship, so that sincerity, patience, gratitude, and truthfulness become manifest.

description_ar_detailed: وضع العبد في ظروف حرجة ليظهر جوهر إيمانه وثباته.
description_tr_detailed: Altının ateşte eritilerek sahtesinden ayrılması gibi, insanları ağır imtihan süzgeçlerinden geçirerek saf müminleri ayıklamasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah tests hearts through trials so that sincerity, hypocrisy, patience, and truthfulness become manifest.

description_ar_detailed: تنقية بواطن المؤمنين من أدناس الأخلاق وأرجاس المعاصي.
description_tr_detailed: Kulunun kalbini şirkten, nifaktan, kötü ahlaktan temizleyerek onu tertemiz ve huzurlu bir ruh haline ulaştırmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah purifies whom He wills from sins, spiritual stains, and corrupt traits through repentance, worship, and mercy.

description_ar_detailed: تطهير العبد وإعلاء روحه بالتقوى، قد أفلح من زكاها.
description_tr_detailed: İman ve salih ameller vasıtasıyla kulun maneviyatını bereketlendirip onu kâmil insan mertebesine yükseltmesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah nurtures and purifies souls, increasing them in faith, righteousness, and nearness to Him.

meaning_ar_short: بسط الرزق لمن يشاء من عباده.
description_ar_detailed: إفاضة المال والخيرات المدرارة رغداً من العيش لحكمة يعلمها.
description_tr_detailed: Dilediği kuluna hikmeti gereği servet, mülk ve geniş geçim kaynakları bahşederek onu bolluk içinde yaşatmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah expands provision for whom He wills, granting abundance as a blessing, trial, or wisdom known to Him.

description_ar_detailed: حبس فضول الدنيا عن العبد حماية لدينه أو ابتلاءً لصبره.
description_tr_detailed: Kulunu korumak veya imtihan etmek için onun maddi gelirlerini, rızkını ölçülü ve dar bir seviyede tutması fiilidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah restricts provision for whom He wills, as a test, protection, discipline, or wisdom known to Him.

description_ar_detailed: توجيه مشاعر العباد وإرادتهم، يا مقلب القلوب ثبت قلبي على دينك.
description_tr_detailed: İnsanların kalplerini, niyetlerini ve duygularını dilediği yöne, imana veya inkara doğru evirip çevirmesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah turns hearts as He wills; therefore servants ask Him for firmness upon faith and guidance.

description_ar_detailed: حرمان الكافر المعاند من قبول الحق عقوبة له على كفره المتأصل.
description_tr_detailed: Kendi arzusuyla azgınlaşan ve gerçeği sürekli reddedenlerin kalplerini mühürleyerek iman girmesini engellemesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah seals the hearts of those who persistently reject truth after choosing arrogance and denial.

description_ar_detailed: تنوير البواطن بالهدى والسكينة لتتلقى فيوضات الإيمان برغبة.
description_tr_detailed: İyi niyetli kullarının kalplerini hidayet nuruna, sevgiye, huzura ve yüce gerçeklere ardına kadar açmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah opens hearts to faith, guidance, tranquility, and understanding when He wills good for His servant.

description_ar_detailed: إلقاء الطمأنينة والبهجة في نفس المؤمن فلا يضيق بالتكاليف.
description_tr_detailed: Kulunun içine huzur, cesaret, teslimiyet duyguları salarak İslam'ı yaşama yolunda ona büyük bir kolaylık ve inşirah vermesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah grants inward relief, assurance, patience, and openness to faith to whom He wills, making obedience and truth easier for the servant.

description_ar_detailed: إضعاف عزائم الكافرين بإلقاء الوجل في أفئدتهم نصرة للدين.
description_tr_detailed: Zalimlerin ve kafirlerin kalplerine müminlere karşı büyük bir korku ve panik yerleştirerek onların güçlerini kırmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah may cast fear into the hearts of oppressive enemies and thereby weaken their resolve, in support of truth and justice.

description_ar_detailed: تأمين الخائفين وربط قلوبهم باليقين فلا يتزلزلون.
description_tr_detailed: Savaş, kriz veya tehlike anlarında müminlerin kalplerine sarsılmaz bir güven, emniyet ve huzur duygusu indirmesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah grants safety, tranquility, and assurance to His believing servants, especially in times of fear, hardship, or trial.

meaning_tr_short: Dinlenmesi veya korunması için uyku vermek.
description_ar_detailed: تغشية النعاس للعباد ستراً لهم وراحة لأبدانهم في مواطن الخوف.
description_tr_detailed: Ashab-ı Kehf'i yüzlerce yıl uyutması veya savaş anında müminlere bir güven belirtisi olarak hafif bir uyku vermesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah grants sleep as rest, mercy, protection, or a sign of His power over life and consciousness.

description_ar_detailed: رد اليقظة والإدراك للأجساد بعد النوم الذي هو الموت الأصغر.
description_tr_detailed: Canlıları uykularından uyandırarak yeni bir güne ulaştırması, şuurlarını yeniden açması fiilidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah awakens His servants from sleep and restores their awareness, just as He will resurrect the dead.

description_ar_detailed: التفضل بموجبات الغبطة والابتهاج، وأنه هو أضحك وأبكى.
description_tr_detailed: Kulunun kalbine neşe salarak onu mutlu kılması, yüzünde sevinç tebessümleri yaratması fiilidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah creates joy and laughter, granting happiness and relief to whom He wills.

description_ar_detailed: إسالة الدموع حزناً على فائت أو وجلاً من خشيته تلييناً للقلب.
description_tr_detailed: Kulunu hüzünle imtihan etmesi veya kalbine verdiği haşyetle onun gözlerinden rahmet damlaları akıtmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah creates weeping through sorrow, awe, mercy, or trial, softening hearts and reminding servants of Him.

meaning_tr_short: Maddi veya manevi olarak zengin etmek.
description_ar_detailed: إقالة عثرة المحتاج وصبّ الأموال عليه أو منح قلبه الغنى الحقيقي.
description_tr_detailed: Kulunu kimseye muhtaç etmeyecek mülke ulaştırması veya kalbine kanaat zenginliği vererek aziz kılmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah grants wealth, sufficiency, or inward contentment to whom He wills, according to His wisdom and mercy.

description_ar_detailed: تجريد العبد من المتاع الدنيوي ليعلم افتقاره الذاتي لربه.
description_tr_detailed: Kulunun malını eksilterek onu sabır imtihanına tabi tutması veya azgın zenginleri ibret için fakir bırakmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah may remove wealth or means, making a servant aware of need, dependence, patience, and humility.

meaning_ar_short: تقديم الشيء في الزمان أو الرتبة.
description_ar_detailed: جعل رتبة المخلوق مقدمة حكمة وتقديراً أزلياً.
description_tr_detailed: Dilediği varlığı, peygamberi veya ameli lütfuyla diğerlerinin önüne geçirmesi, öncelik tanımasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah gives precedence in time, rank, honor, or decree to whom and what He wills by His wisdom.

description_ar_detailed: إرجاء العواقب أو حط مرتبة العاصي عقوبة له.
description_tr_detailed: Zalimlerin cezasını veya hak etmeyenlerin derecesini adaleti uyarınca arkaya atması, sonraya bırakmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah delays or sets back whom and what He wills in time, rank, consequence, or decree by His wisdom.

description_ar_detailed: كمال سلطانه العظيم فلا يسأل عما يفعل وهم يسألون، فعال لما يريد.
description_tr_detailed: Kendisini sınırlayacak hiçbir irade bulunmaksızın, mutlak egemenliğiyle kainatta her istediğini yapmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah does whatever He wills with complete power, wisdom, justice, and sovereignty; none can prevent His will.

meaning_tr_short: Arzusu uyarınca yegane kanun koyucu olmak.
description_ar_detailed: انفراد الربوبية بالتشريع والأمر الخالق، إن الله يحكم ما يريد.
description_tr_detailed: Kainatın ve şeriatın yasalarını, kimseye danışmadan, kendi mutlak hikmet ve dilemesine göre belirlemesidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah rules as He wills with perfect justice and wisdom, and no judgment can override His judgment.

description_ar_detailed: لفظ ورد في النصوص مضافاً إلى الله ويراد به ذاته العلية بلا تشبيه ولا تكييف.
description_tr_detailed: Ayetlerde geçen ve Allah'ın mukaddes zatını, ulu varlığını bildiren, keyfiyeti bizce meçhul haberî sıfattır.
description_en_detailed: A scriptural expression referring to Allah's exalted Self. It is affirmed without likening Allah to created beings and without asking how.

meaning_ar_short: صفة خبرية وردت في النصوص وتدل على ما يليق بجلال الله من غير تشبيه.
description_ar_detailed: صفة وجه الله الثابتة بالنصوص بما يليق بجلاله، ويبقى وجه ربك ذو الجلال والإكرام.
description_tr_detailed: Nasslarda geçen, Allah'ın beka sıfatını ve mukaddes vechini bildiren, kula benzemekten uzak ezeli sıfatıdır.
description_en_detailed: A scriptural attribute affirmed for Allah as befits His majesty. It is not understood as a created face, bodily form, or resemblance to creation.

meaning_ar_short: صفة خبرية وردت في النصوص وتثبت لله على وجه يليق به بلا جارحة ولا تشبيه.
description_ar_detailed: يد الله الثابتة بالكتاب بلا تجسيم، يد الله فوق أيديهم.
description_tr_detailed: Ayet ve hadislerde zikredilen, Allah'ın tasarrufunu ve kudretini simgeleyen, el kavramından münezzeh sıfattır.
description_en_detailed: A scriptural attribute affirmed for Allah in a manner befitting Him, without bodily organs, created form, or resemblance to creation.

meaning_tr_short: İki el (Haberî vasıf - tam noksansız kudret).
description_ar_detailed: إثبات ما قاله الله في كتابه خروجاً عن التعطيل والتأويل المذموم، لما خلقت بيدي.
description_tr_detailed: Hz. Adem'in yaratılışı gibi hususi ihtimam ve tam kudret gerektiren fiillerde geçen haberî sıfattır.
description_en_detailed: A scriptural expression affirmed for Allah as He revealed it, without likening it to created limbs and without asking about its modality.

meaning_ar_short: صفة خبرية تدل على الرعاية والحفظ بما يليق بجلال الله.
description_ar_detailed: رعاية الله التامة المعبر عنها بالعين نصاً بلا تمثيل، ولتصنع على عيني.
description_tr_detailed: Hz. Musa'ya hitaben 'Gözümün önünde yetişesin diye' ayetinde geçen, maddi organ manasından uzak koruma vasfıdır.
description_en_detailed: A scriptural attribute indicating Allah's perfect care and protection, affirmed without bodily resemblance or created organs.

description_ar_detailed: إثبات اللفظ القرآني مع تنزيه الخالق عن الجوارح، تجري بأعيننا.
description_tr_detailed: Nuh'un gemisinin yapılışında geçen 'Gözlerimizin önünde yap' beyanındaki, tam emniyet bildiren haberî nitelemedir.
description_en_detailed: A scriptural expression denoting Allah's complete care, watchfulness, and protection, affirmed without resembling created eyes.

description_ar_detailed: إثبات ما ورد في القرآن دون إرادة الجارحة الفيزيائية، يا حسرتا على ما فرطت في جنب الله.
description_tr_detailed: Ayet-i kerimede geçen 'Allah'ın yanında (hakkında) yaptığım kusurlardan ötürü' ifadesindeki haberî sıfattır.
description_en_detailed: A Qur'anic expression understood in a manner befitting Allah's majesty, without attributing bodily side, form, or limitation to Him.

description_ar_detailed: إحاطة قدرته بالأجرام السماوية والأرضية، والأرض جميعاً قبضته يوم القيامة.
description_tr_detailed: 'Kıyamet günü arz tamamen O'nun kabzasındadır' ayetinde bildirilen, mutlak hakimiyeti gösteren haberî niteliktir.
description_en_detailed: A scriptural expression indicating Allah's absolute dominion and power over the earth and all creation on the Day of Resurrection, without bodily likeness.

meaning_ar_short: صفة خبرية تدل على القوة واليمين.
description_ar_detailed: إثبات اليمين لله كما أخبر عن نفسه مع التنزيه المطلق عن صفات المحدثات.
description_tr_detailed: Göklerin Allah'ın sağ eliyle dürüleceğini bildiren ayetlerde geçen, şeref ve kuvvet ifade eden haberî kelimedir.
description_en_detailed: A scriptural attribute affirmed in a manner befitting Allah's majesty, indicating honor, power, and complete dominion, without bodily resemblance.

meaning_ar_short: صفة خبرية وردت في النصوص وتثبت لله على وجه يليق بجلاله بلا تكييف ولا تشبيه.
description_ar_detailed: يوم يكشف عن ساق، آية تفيد شدة الحساب وظهور الحقائق الكبرى بلا شبهة.
description_tr_detailed: Kur’ân ve hadislerde geçen bu lafız, Ehl-i Sünnet çizgisinde Allah’a yaraşan şekilde kabul edilir; keyfiyeti bilinmez, yaratılmışların organ ve uzuvlarına benzetilmez.
description_en_detailed: This scriptural expression is affirmed in a manner befitting Allah's majesty. Its modality is unknown, and it is not likened to the limbs of created beings.

meaning_ar_short: علوه على العرش بما يليق به.
description_ar_detailed: الرحمن على العرش استوى، نؤمن به كما ورد بلا تكييف ولا تمثيل ولا جلوس ولا مماسة، مع تنزيه الله عن صفات المحدثات.
description_tr_detailed: Allah’ın Arş’a istivâsı naslarda bildirildiği şekilde kabul edilir; keyfiyeti bilinmez. Bu ifade oturma, yerleşme, temas, ihtiyaç veya mekânla sınırlanma anlamında anlaşılmaz.
description_en_detailed: Allah's istiwâ over the Throne is affirmed as revealed, with its modality unknown. It does not imply sitting, contact, need, spatial confinement, or resemblance to creation.

description_ar_detailed: وهو القاهر فوق عباده، فوقية استعلاء بالقدرة والسلطان لا بالمكان الجسماني.
description_tr_detailed: 'O, kullarının üstünde yegane hakimdir' ayetindeki, üstünlük ve kahr ifade eden mekan dışı haberî vasıftır.
description_en_detailed: This denotes Allah's absolute supremacy, authority, and exaltedness over His creation, without implying spatial confinement or created direction.

description_ar_detailed: تنزهه عن السفل والنقائص، وهو العلي العظيم علواً مطلقاً.
description_tr_detailed: Allah'ın her türlü noksanlıktan fersah fersah yüksekte bulunması, azametinin her şeyi aşmasıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah is exalted above every imperfection, partner, rival, and resemblance to creation. His exaltedness befits His majesty.

description_ar_detailed: ينزل ربنا كل ليلة إلى السماء الدنيا، نزول يليق بجلاله، أوله نزول أمره ورحمته.
description_tr_detailed: Hadislerde bildirilen nüzûl, Allah’a yaraşan şekilde kabul edilir; keyfiyeti bilinmez. Bu, yaratılmışların hareketi, yer değiştirmesi veya mekâna muhtaç olması gibi anlaşılmaz.
description_en_detailed: The descent mentioned in authentic reports is affirmed in a manner befitting Allah's majesty, without likening it to created movement, relocation, or need of place.

description_ar_detailed: وجاء ربك والملك صفاً صفاً، مجيء يليق به سبحانه لفصل القضاء بين خلقه.
description_tr_detailed: 'Rabbin geldiği zaman' ayetinde kıyamet günü emir ve azametin tecellisini bildiren keyfiyetsiz haberî sıfattır.
description_en_detailed: The coming mentioned in revelation is affirmed in a manner befitting Allah's majesty, especially in relation to judgment, without likening it to created movement.

description_ar_detailed: هل ينظرون إلا أن يأتيهم الله في ظلل من الغمام، إتيان جلال لا تشبيه فيه.
description_tr_detailed: Bulut gölgeleri içinde Allah'ın azabının gelmesini ifade eden ayetlerdeki haberî lafızdır.
description_en_detailed: This scriptural expression is affirmed as befits Allah's majesty and is not understood as created motion, travel, or bodily arrival.

description_ar_detailed: جعل العبد مقرباً حظوة ورضا بفضل طاعته وجهاده.
description_tr_detailed: Kulların ibadetlerle Allah katında kazandıkları manevi mertebe ve yakınlaşma taallukudur.
description_en_detailed: A scripturally affirmed attribute of Allah related to spiritual Closeness; it is accepted in a manner befitting His majesty, without resemblance to creation and without asking how.

description_ar_detailed: وهو معكم أينما كنتم، معية الإحاطة البالغة والعلم الشامل لكافة الخلائق.
description_tr_detailed: Nerede olursanız olun O'nun sizinle olduğunu bildiren, mekansız ilmi kuşatıcılıktır.
description_en_detailed: This refers to Allah's all-encompassing knowledge, awareness, hearing, seeing, care, and support. It does not mean that Allah is contained within creation.

description_ar_detailed: صفة كلامه القديم المسموع حقيقة بلفظه ومعناه من غير خلق ولا حدوث.
description_tr_detailed: Mahluk (yaratılmış) olmayan, ezeli kelam sıfatının indirilmiş harf ve mushaf formundaki tecellisidir.
description_en_detailed: The Qur'an is the speech of Allah. Allah's speech is affirmed as befits His majesty, without likening it to created speech or created need.

description_ar_detailed: وناديناه من جانب الطور الأيمن، نداء مسموع يليق بالخالق العظيم.
description_tr_detailed: Hz. Musa'ya Tur vadisinde seslenmesi gibi, harf ve savt zaaflarından uzak haberî hitap şeklidir.
description_en_detailed: Allah's calling and address are affirmed as befits His majesty, as in His address to Mûsâ, without likening His speech to created voices or instruments.

description_ar_detailed: وقربناه نجياً، إكرام الله لخاصة رسله بمكالمة خفية شريفة.
description_tr_detailed: Allah'ın kulunu hususi olarak yaklaştırıp onunla gizlice konuşmasını simgeleyen nasslardaki vasıftır.
description_en_detailed: This denotes Allah's honoring of selected servants by intimate address and nearness, in a manner befitting His majesty.

description_ar_detailed: وجوه يومئذ ناضرة إلى ربها ناظرة، أعظم نعيم أهل الجنان.
description_tr_detailed: Cennet ehlinin, yön, mesafe ve sınır olmaksızın Allah Teâlâ'yı gözleriyle görecek olmaları hakikatidir.
description_en_detailed: The believers' vision of Allah in the Hereafter is affirmed without encompassing Him, without direction or limitation, and without likening Him to creation.

description_ar_detailed: رضي الله عنهم، صفة ذاتية/فعلية ثابتة بنصوص الوحي الكريم.
description_tr_detailed: Kulun amellerinden memnun kalıp onu sevmesini anlatan haberî sıfatlardan biridir.
description_en_detailed: Allah's pleasure is affirmed as a true divine attribute befitting His majesty toward faith, obedience, and righteousness, without resemblance to created emotion.

description_ar_detailed: وغضب الله عليه ولعنه، صفة تقتضي شدة الانتقام من الكافر.
description_tr_detailed: Nefsî bir kabarma olmaksızın, asilere yönelik ilahi öfkeyi bildiren nass kaynaklı sıfattır.
description_en_detailed: Allah's wrath is affirmed as befits His majesty against disbelief, injustice, and rebellion, without resemblance to human anger or agitation.

description_ar_detailed: فسوف يأتي الله بقوم يحبهم ويحبونه، صفة تليق بكماله القدس.
description_tr_detailed: Kutsal metinlerde Allah'ın müminleri sevdiğini beyan eden duygu benzerliğinden uzak haberî sıfattır.
description_en_detailed: Allah's love is affirmed as befits His majesty for His righteous servants, without resemblance to created affection or need.

description_ar_detailed: كتب ربكم على نفسه الرحمة، إيجاب الفضل واللطف على المخلوق.
description_tr_detailed: Kalp yufkalığı olmaksızın, Allah'ın yaratıklarına şefkatini nasslarla bildiren ezeli sıfattır.
description_en_detailed: Allah's mercy is affirmed as a true attribute befitting His majesty, encompassing creation by His grace and reaching the believers with special favor.

description_ar_detailed: لله أشد فرحاً بتوبة عبده، فرح رضا وقبول لا يشبه فرح المخلوقين.
description_tr_detailed: Hadiste geçen 'Allah kulunun tövbesine sevinir' ifadesindeki, insani neşeden uzak mutlak hoşnutluk sıfatıdır.
description_en_detailed: The joy mentioned in authentic reports is affirmed in a manner befitting Allah's majesty, indicating His acceptance of repentance, without resemblance to created emotion.

description_ar_detailed: ضحك يليق بجلاله، يفيد غاية الكرم والرضا عن صنيع الشهداء.
description_tr_detailed: Hadislerde geçen 'Allah güler' beyanının, insan gibi dişlerin görünmesi veya ses çıkarmaktan münezzeh, tam bir rıza manasındaki haberî sıfatıdır.
description_en_detailed: The laughter mentioned in authentic reports is affirmed in a manner befitting Allah's majesty, without likening it to human laughter or bodily expression.

description_ar_detailed: عجب إعظام واستحسان لأفعال البر الفاضلة لا جهل فيه بالعواقب.
description_tr_detailed: Hadislerde yer alan 'Rabbiniz şaşırdı/beğendi' ifadesindeki, bilinmeyen bir şey karşısında şoka girmekten uzak, takdir etme sıfatıdır.
description_en_detailed: The wonder mentioned in authentic reports is understood as a divine attribute befitting Allah's majesty, indicating approval or greatness of the matter, without ignorance or surprise.

description_ar_detailed: بغض الفعل وعدم إرادة وقوعه شرفاً، كره الله انبعاثهم.
description_tr_detailed: Münafıkların savaşa çıkmasını Allah'ın kerih görmesi ayetindeki, onların amellerini engelleme muradıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah's disapproval of certain deeds is affirmed as befits His majesty, without resembling created dislike or emotional disturbance.

description_ar_detailed: فلما آسفونا انتقمنا منهم، أي أغضبونا بارتكاب القبائح المتكررة.
description_tr_detailed: 'Bizi eseflendirince (öfkelendirince) onlardan intikam aldık' ayetindeki haberî sıfattır.
description_en_detailed: This scriptural expression denotes Allah's wrath and punishment against persistent wrongdoing, affirmed without resemblance to created anger.

meaning_ar_short: صفة خبرية تدل على الكرم والحياء اللائق بجلال الله بلا مشابهة للمخلوقين.
meaning_tr_short: Hayâ etmek; kuluna ikram etmekten geri durmamak (Haberî vasıf).
description_ar_detailed: حياء كرم وجود وبر، لا حياء انقباض وخوف، يستحي من عبده إذا رفع يديه.
description_tr_detailed: Hadisteki 'Allah elini açan kulunu boş çevirmekten haya eder' nassındaki, kerem ve cömertlik bildiren haberî sıfattır.
description_en_detailed: The modesty mentioned in authentic reports is affirmed as befits Allah's majesty, indicating generosity and noble refusal to turn away sincere supplication empty.

meaning_ar_short: صفة خبرية تدل على حلم الله وإمهاله للعصاة وعدم معاجلتهم بالعقوبة.
description_ar_detailed: صفة خبرية تؤكد عدم معاجلته للعصاة مع سماع شركهم وافترائهم.
description_tr_detailed: Hadiste geçen 'Duyduğu eziyete Allah'tan daha sabırlı kimse yoktur' ifadesindeki mühlet verme sıfatıdır.
description_en_detailed: Allah's forbearance and patience are affirmed in the sense that He does not hasten punishment despite hearing the offenses of His servants, out of wisdom and mercy.

description_ar_detailed: علم على الذات الواجب الوجود، المستحق لجميع المحامد, جامع صفات الجلال.
description_tr_detailed: Bütün güzel isimleri ve sıfatları kendisinde toplayan, varlığı zorunlu olan tek yaratıcının özel ismi.
description_en_detailed: The proper name of the One true God, who alone possesses all perfection, lordship, worship-worthiness, and the most beautiful names.

meaning_ar_short: واسع الرحمة لجميع الخلق في الدنيا.
description_ar_detailed: ذو الرحمة الشاملة التي وسعت المؤمن والكافر والجماد والنبات في الأولى.
description_tr_detailed: Ayırt etmeksizin dünyadaki bütün canlılara rızık veren, şefkat gösteren ezeli merhamet sahibi.
description_en_detailed: Allah is the All-Merciful, whose mercy encompasses all creation in this world with life, provision, care, and countless blessings.

description_ar_detailed: المفيض برحمته الخاصة على عباده المتقين يوم القيامة جزاء إيمانهم.
description_tr_detailed: Verdiği nimetleri iyi kullananlara, ahiret hayatında hususi ihsanlarda bulunan merhamet kaynağı.
description_en_detailed: Allah is especially merciful to the believers, granting them guidance in this world and special mercy and reward in the Hereafter.

description_ar_detailed: الذي يستغني في ذاته وصفاته عن كل موجود، ويحتاج إليه كل موجود.
description_tr_detailed: Görünen ve görünmeyen alemlerin yegane sultanı, idarecisi ve emir hakkı kendisinde olan padişah.
description_en_detailed: Allah is the absolute Sovereign, Owner, and King of all realms. His dominion is complete and none shares His rule.

description_ar_detailed: الطاهر من الشبيه والنظير, المنزه عن صفات الأجسام والحدوث.
description_tr_detailed: Hata, gaflet, acizlik gibi mahlukata has kusurlardan tertemiz, mukaddes ve yüce olan zat.
description_en_detailed: Allah is utterly pure and holy, exalted above every defect, imperfection, partner, likeness, and created attribute.

description_ar_detailed: الذي سلمت ذاته من العيب, وصفاته من النقص, وأفعاله من الشر المطلق.
description_tr_detailed: Kullarını tehlikelerden selamette kılan, kendisi de her türlü zevalden salim olan esenlik kaynağı.
description_en_detailed: Allah is free from every defect and is the source of true peace, safety, and salvation for those whom He protects.

meaning_en_short: The Guardian of Faith / Giver of Security
description_ar_detailed: الذي يؤمن عباده من الخوف والظلم، المصدق لرسله بإظهار المعجزات.
description_tr_detailed: Kalplere iman ışığı serpen, kendisine sığınanları korkulardan emin kılan sarsılmaz kale.
description_en_detailed: Allah grants security, confirms the truth of His messengers, and gives faith and safety to whom He wills. He is the true source of trust and assurance.

description_ar_detailed: الرقيب الشاهد على خلقه بأعمالهم, الحافظ لهم في حركاتهم وسكناتهم.
description_tr_detailed: Kainatın bütün işlerini kontrol altında tutan, mahlukatı her an izleyen ve koruyuculuğu mutlak olan.
description_en_detailed: Allah watches over, preserves, witnesses, and safeguards all creation. Nothing escapes His knowledge, protection, and authority.

description_ar_detailed: العزيز الذي قل وجود مثله, واشتدت الحاجة إليه, وصعب الوصول إليه.
description_tr_detailed: İzzet ve şerefi mutlak olan, her şeye galip gelen, mağlup edilmesi asla mümkün olmayan yüce sultan.
description_en_detailed: Allah is Almighty and unconquerable. All might belongs to Him, and nothing can overcome His command or decree.

description_ar_detailed: الذي تنفذ مشيئته في كل شيء على سبيل الإجبار, ويجبر كسر الضعفاء.
description_tr_detailed: Eksikleri tamamlayan, dilediğini yaptırmaya muktedir olan, azameti karşısında zorbaların dize geldiği muktedir.
description_en_detailed: Allah compels His creation by His will and power, restores the broken, and subdues the arrogant with perfect justice.

description_ar_detailed: الذي يرى غيره حقيرًا بالنسبة إلى ذاته, فلا يرى العظمة إلا لنفسه.
description_tr_detailed: Büyüklükte ortağı bulunmayan, her şeyde azametini gösteren, kibirlenen kibirlileri hakir kılan.
description_en_detailed: Allah alone possesses true greatness and majesty. He is exalted above all created pride, deficiency, and limitation.

description_ar_detailed: المقدر للأشياء صانعها على مقتضى علمه وحكمته البالغة.
description_tr_detailed: Her şeyin ölçüsünü, biçimini ve niteliklerini ezelde takdir edip yokluktan çıkaran usta sanatkâr.
description_en_detailed: Allah creates all things from nonexistence according to His knowledge, will, wisdom, and perfect measure.

description_ar_detailed: الذي يخرج الخلق من العدم إلى الوجود متميزاً بعضه عن بعض بالصور.
description_tr_detailed: Yarattığı mahlukatı maddesiyle ve azalarıyla birbirine uyumlu, kusursuz ve pürüzsüz meydana getiren.
description_en_detailed: Allah brings creation into being in distinct, ordered, and harmonious forms, free from defect in His act of creating.

description_ar_detailed: مرتب ترتيبًا يمنح كل مخلوق صورته الخاصة وهيأته الفريدة.
description_tr_detailed: Her mahluka kendine has bir yüz, renk, estetik ve benzersiz bir kimlik sureti bahşeden.
description_en_detailed: Allah gives every creature its form, shape, appearance, proportion, and distinctive qualities according to His wisdom.

description_ar_detailed: الذي أظهر الجميل وستر القبيح في الدنيا وتجاوز عنه في الآخرة.
description_tr_detailed: Kullarının suçlarını örten, tövbe ettikçe bağışlamasını yineleyen sonsuz merhamet sahibi.
description_en_detailed: Allah repeatedly forgives and covers the sins of His servants when they repent and turn to Him sincerely.

meaning_tr_short: Her şeye galip gelen mutlak güç.
description_ar_detailed: الذي قصم ظهَار الأكاسرة بالإماتة والإذلال، فلا يخرج شيء عن قبضته.
description_tr_detailed: İradesine karşı durulamayan, azgınları helak eden, her varlığı emri altında ezen mutlak hakim.
description_en_detailed: Allah subdues all powers and nothing can resist His authority. The might of every tyrant is under His command.

description_ar_detailed: الذي يجود بالعطاء الواسع من غير غرض ولا طلب شكر.
description_tr_detailed: Hiçbir bedel ve mükafat beklemeden, kullarına lütfundan sonsuz nimetler ve hediyeler akıtan cömert.
description_en_detailed: Allah bestows gifts and blessings freely, without need of return, and His giving is vast, generous, and unbounded.

description_ar_detailed: المفيض بالأقوات على النفوس والقلوب لتستقيم الحياة الإنسانية.
description_tr_detailed: Bedenlerin rızkı olan gıdaları ve ruhların rızkı olan ilim ve imanı halk edip dağıtan.
description_en_detailed: Allah provides for all creatures, giving them what sustains their bodies, hearts, and lives according to His wisdom.

description_ar_detailed: الذي بعنايته ينفتح كل مغلق، وبحكمه ينفصل القضاء بين عباده بالعدل والحق.
description_tr_detailed: Maddi kapıları zaferle, manevi kapıları ilimle açan, kulları arasındaki düğümleri adaletle çözen.
description_en_detailed: Allah opens what is closed, grants relief and victory, and judges between His servants with perfect justice.

description_ar_detailed: الذي لا يعزب عن علمه مثقال ذرة، يعلم خائنة الأعين وما تخفي الصدور.
description_tr_detailed: Zaman ve mekân sınırı olmadan, olmuş, olan ve olacak her zerre bilgiyi tam olarak bilen.
description_en_detailed: Allah knows all things completely: the seen and unseen, the past and future, the outward and inward.

description_ar_detailed: الذي يحبس الأرزاق والخيرات بحكمته البالغة امتحاناً للعباد.
description_tr_detailed: Hikmeti gereği bazı kullarının rızkını sıkıştıran, eceli gelenlerin ruhunu kabzeden tasarruf sahibi.
description_en_detailed: Allah withholds, constricts, and takes according to His wisdom, including provision, hearts, and souls at their appointed time.

description_ar_detailed: الذي يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء بجوده، وينشر السعادة في النفوس.
description_tr_detailed: Rızıkları cömertçe yayan, kalplere genişlik salıp kullarını neşelendiren lütufkar.
description_en_detailed: Allah expands provision, mercy, hearts, and relief for whom He wills according to His generosity and wisdom.

description_ar_detailed: الذي يخفض الكفار بالأشقياء، ويحط قدر الطغاة صغاراً.
description_tr_detailed: Kibirlenenleri, hakka başkaldıranları zillet koltuğuna oturtup aşağıların aşağısına indiren.
description_en_detailed: Allah lowers the arrogant and the unjust, removing false rank and exposing weakness by His justice.

description_ar_detailed: الذي يرفع أولياءه بالإسعاد، ويعلي كلمة الحق فوق كل باطل.
description_tr_detailed: Mümin kullarını hidayet ve salih amellerle şereflendirip makamlarını göklere yükselten.
description_en_detailed: Allah raises the ranks of whom He wills through faith, knowledge, obedience, and His generous favor.

description_ar_detailed: الذي يعز من يشاء بنور الهداية وطاعته الشريفة في الدارين.
description_tr_detailed: İtaat eden kullarını dünyada zaferle, ahirette cemaliyle şereflendirip aziz eyleyen.
description_en_detailed: Allah grants honor, dignity, strength, and victory to whom He wills, and true honor belongs to Him alone.

description_ar_detailed: الذي يذل أعداءه بالخذلان وحرمانهم من أبواب اللطف والنصر.
description_tr_detailed: Nefsine ve şeytana uyan zalimleri, hidayetten mahrum bırakarak rezilliğe mahkum eden.
description_en_detailed: Allah abases whom He wills by His justice, especially those who persist in arrogance, rebellion, and falsehood.

meaning_ar_short: سامع كل الأصوات بلا آلة ولا حد.
description_ar_detailed: الذي لا يَعزب عن سمعه سرّ ولا نجوى، مستجيب لمن دعاه.
description_tr_detailed: Kâinattaki en gizli fısıltıları, kalplerin derinliklerindeki duaları işitip cevap veren.
description_en_detailed: Allah hears every sound, supplication, whisper, and secret without instrument, limitation, or deficiency.

meaning_ar_short: مبصر كل موجود خفيًا أو جليًا.
description_ar_detailed: الذي يشهد الأشياء كلها تحت نظره الشريف فلا يغيب عنه باطن.
description_tr_detailed: Karanlık gecede, kara taşın üzerindeki siyah karıncanın yürüyüşünü dahi görecek bir ihata sahibi.
description_en_detailed: Allah sees all things, hidden and manifest, without need of eyes, light, distance, or direction.

description_ar_detailed: الذي لا راد لقضائه, ولا معقب لحكمه, يفصل الخصومات بالحق.
description_tr_detailed: Hüküm verme salahiyeti sadece kendisine ait olan, kararı bozulmayan ve tam adaletle hükmeden.
description_en_detailed: Allah is the true Judge whose judgment is final, just, wise, and free from error or injustice.

meaning_ar_short: ذو العدل المطلق المنزه عن الجور.
description_ar_detailed: الذي تجري أفعاله كلها على مقتضى الصواب والحكمة بلا ميل.
description_tr_detailed: Asla zulmetmeyen, her şeyi tam yerine koyan, hak sahiplerine haklarını eksiksiz dağıtan.
description_en_detailed: Allah is perfectly just; He places everything in its proper place and never wrongs anyone in the least.

description_ar_detailed: الذي يوصل المنافع الشريفة إلى مستحقيها بأساليب خفية لطيفة.
description_tr_detailed: En gizli işleri incelikleriyle bilen, kullarına sezdirmeden muazzam hayırlar ulaştıran.
