description_en_detailed: Allah knows the subtlest realities and conveys kindness to His servants through gentle and hidden means.

description_ar_detailed: الذي لا يخفى عليه ما في الكون من مضمرات ونوايا دفينة.
description_tr_detailed: Maddelerin özünü, kalplerin sakladığı sırları ve olayların perde arkasını eksiksiz bilen haberdar.
description_en_detailed: Allah is fully aware of the inner realities of all things, including intentions, secrets, causes, and outcomes.

meaning_ar_short: ذو الأناة الذي لا يستفزه عصيان.
description_ar_detailed: الذي يرى معصية المخالفين فلا يعاجلهم بالنقمة رفقاً بهم.
description_tr_detailed: Kullarının isyanlarına karşı hemen öfkelenip azap etmeyen, onlara tövbe etmeleri için fırsat sunan.
description_en_detailed: Allah is forbearing; He does not hasten punishment for sinners, but gives respite and opens the door to repentance.

description_ar_detailed: الذي جاوزت عظمته حدود العقول فلا تدرك كنه ذاته.
description_tr_detailed: Akılların büyüklüğünü kavrayamayacağı derecede yüce, kibriyası ve saltanatı sonsuz olan.
description_en_detailed: Allah is magnificent in majesty, greatness, and power; created minds cannot encompass the fullness of His greatness.

description_ar_detailed: الذي يغفر ذنوباً عظاماً ويمحو سيئات المكلفين بفضل جوده.
description_tr_detailed: Büyük günahları bile rahmet deryasında eriterek örten, mağfireti kulun kusurlarından büyük olan.
description_en_detailed: Allah forgives abundantly, covering sins and removing their consequences for those whom He forgives by His mercy.

description_ar_detailed: الذي يثيب على يسير الطاعات بكثير من النعم العالية.
description_tr_detailed: Kullarının küçük bir iyiliğine bile devasa cennet makamları ve ebedi nimetlerle teşekkür mahiyetinde karşılık veren.
description_en_detailed: Allah appreciates even small righteous deeds and rewards them with multiplied grace far beyond what His servants deserve.

meaning_ar_short: رفيع القدر والمقام فوق كل خلق.
description_ar_detailed: الذي له العلو المطلق علو الذات والقهر والشأن مجداً.
description_tr_detailed: Kendisine eş koşulan her şeyden yüce, rütbe ve izzetçe akılların ötesinde yüksek olan.
description_en_detailed: Allah is Most High in essence, rank, power, and perfection, exalted above every defect and resemblance to creation.

description_ar_detailed: الذي كل شيء دون جلاله صغير حقير, كبرياؤه لا يحد.
description_tr_detailed: Zatının büyüklüğüne sınır bulunmayan, kâinatı kudret elinde küçük bir zerre gibi tutan.
description_en_detailed: Allah is supremely great; all greatness in creation is insignificant before His majesty and dominion.

description_ar_detailed: الذي يحفظ السماوات والأرض بقدرته, ويحفظ جوارح العباد.
description_tr_detailed: Yaratıklarını yok olmaktan, düzeni bozulmaktan koruyan, kulların amellerini tek bir zerre zayi etmeden saklayan.
description_en_detailed: Allah preserves creation, protects His servants, and records deeds so that nothing is lost or forgotten.

description_ar_detailed: المقتدر الذي يوصل القوت إلى الأبدان والقلوب كفاية.
description_tr_detailed: Her canlıya yetecek gıdayı tayin eden, her canlının yaşam azığını muhafaza edip ulaştıran muktedir.
description_en_detailed: Allah sustains and nourishes every creature, giving each its appointed provision and maintaining its existence.

description_ar_detailed: الذي يكفي العباد شؤونهم ويحصي حركاتهم مجازاة بالحق.
description_tr_detailed: Kullarının hayat amellerini en ince ayrıntısıyla hesaba çeken, kendisine güvenenlere bir hami olarak tek başına yeten.
description_en_detailed: Allah is sufficient for His servants and will bring them to account with perfect knowledge and justice.

description_ar_detailed: المنفرد بصفات المجد والرفعة والقدر العظيم كبرياءً.
description_tr_detailed: Sıfatları yüce, azameti korku ve saygı uyandıran, mutlak heybet sahibi ulu yaradan.
description_en_detailed: Allah is majestic, possessing perfect glory, greatness, nobility, and awe-inspiring exaltedness.

meaning_ar_short: كثير الخير الجواد بلا بخل ولا إمساك.
description_ar_detailed: الذي إذا قدر عفا, وإذا وعد وفى, وإذا أعطى زاد على المنى.
description_tr_detailed: İstemeden veren, affetmeyi seven, vaat ettiğinde yerine getiren sonsuz cömertlik kapısı.
description_en_detailed: Allah is generous, noble, and bountiful; He gives, forgives, honors, and fulfills His promises.

meaning_ar_short: الحافظ الذي لا يغيب عنه شيء.
description_ar_detailed: الرقيب الذي يرعى الأمور ويشهد الخفايا فلا يفوته باطن.
description_tr_detailed: Mahlukatın her nefesini, her hareketini tam bir dikkatle ve anbean denetleyen ilahi gözcü.
description_en_detailed: Allah watches over all things at every moment; no movement, intention, or hidden matter escapes Him.

description_ar_detailed: الذي يقابل دعاء العباد بالإجابة وطلبهم بالإعطاء رأفة.
description_tr_detailed: Kendisine el açıp yalvaranların yakarışlarını işitip, onları çaresiz ve yalnız bırakmayan karşılık verici.
description_en_detailed: Allah answers the supplications of His servants according to His mercy, wisdom, knowledge, and decree.

description_ar_detailed: الذي لا تنفد خزائنه, ولا تنتهي رحمته, محيط بكل موجود.
description_tr_detailed: İlmi, rahmeti, mağfireti ve zenginliği her şeyi içine alacak kadar sonsuz ve geniş olan.
description_en_detailed: Allah's knowledge, mercy, power, and provision are vast, encompassing all creation without limit or exhaustion.

meaning_tr_short: Her işi hikmetli ve kusursuz olan.
description_ar_detailed: الذي يعرف أفضل الأشياء بأفضل العلوم, وأفعاله متقنة.
description_tr_detailed: Yarattığı her şeyde bir gaye, fayda ve mükemmellik bulunan, abes iş yapmaktan münezzeh zat.
description_en_detailed: Allah is All-Wise; every act, command, creation, and decree of His is founded upon perfect wisdom.

description_ar_detailed: الذي يتودد إلى خلقه بنعمه، ويرضى عنهم بأيسر الأعمال.
description_tr_detailed: Salih kullarını hususi bir aşkla seven, kendini onlara sevdiren, şefkati eşsiz olan.
description_en_detailed: Allah is the Loving, who loves His righteous servants and places love for Him in their hearts.

description_ar_detailed: الجامع لكمال الشرف والروعة والفضل الواسع العميم.
description_tr_detailed: Zatının haysiyeti ve şerefi sonsuz yüksek, ihsanları kullarına karşı sınırsız olan ulu sultan.
description_en_detailed: Allah is glorious and noble, perfect in majesty, honor, generosity, and greatness.

description_ar_detailed: الذي يبعث الموتى من القبور حقيقة، ويبعث الرسل لهداية الناس.
description_tr_detailed: Kıyametten sonra çürümüş bedenleri toplayıp yeniden canlandıran, gaflet kalplerine hidayet uyandıran.
description_en_detailed: Allah resurrects the dead, sends messengers, and awakens hearts from heedlessness by His guidance.

description_ar_detailed: الذي لا يغيب عنه شيء, عليم بالظواهر كعلمه بالبواطن.
description_tr_detailed: Hiçbir şey kendisinden gizlenemeyen, her hadiseye bizzat şahit olan yegane bilirkişi.
description_en_detailed: Allah witnesses all things directly and completely; nothing is absent from His knowledge or testimony.

meaning_tr_short: Varlığı gerçek olan, hakkı ilan eden.
description_ar_detailed: الذي وجوده ذاتي واجب, وكل شيء سواه باهت زائل.
description_tr_detailed: Yokluğu imkansız olan yegane gerçek varlık, adaleti ve sözleri tam hakikat olan güven kaynağı.
description_en_detailed: Allah is the Truth, whose existence is necessary and whose words, promises, judgment, and religion are true without falsehood.

description_ar_detailed: الذي يقوم بأمور عباده كفاية ورعاية لمن فوض إليه أمره.
description_tr_detailed: Kendisine tevekkül eden kullarının işlerini en mükemmel şekilde neticelendiren yegane sığınak.
description_en_detailed: Allah is the One upon whom His servants rely. He suffices, protects, and disposes of affairs with perfect knowledge, mercy, and wisdom.

meaning_ar_short: ذو القدرة التامة التي لا يمسها عجز.
description_ar_detailed: الكامل القدرة، الغالب فوق كل مقاومة، لا يعجزه شيء.
description_tr_detailed: Gücü hiçbir sınır tanımayan, kâinatı yönetirken asla yorulmayan mutlak kuvvet sahibi.
description_en_detailed: Allah is strong with perfect power; weakness, fatigue, and inability can never touch Him.

description_ar_detailed: الذي لا تنقص قوته بالافعال العظيمة ولا يلحقه وهن.
description_tr_detailed: Kuvvetinde hiçbir gevşeme, azalma veya sarsıntı meydana gelmeyen, direnci mutlak olan.
description_en_detailed: Allah is firm and mighty in power; His strength is never diminished and His decree cannot be resisted.

description_ar_detailed: الناصر لأوليائه, يتولى أمورهم باللطف والكفاية الجميلة.
description_tr_detailed: İyi kullarını sahiplenen, onlara yardım eden, karanlıklardan nura çıkaran merhametli hami.
description_en_detailed: Allah is the protecting Friend and Patron of the believers. He supports them, guides them, and brings them from darkness into light.

description_ar_detailed: المحمود في ذاته وصفاته وأفعاله حكمة، صاحب الفضل الجلي.
description_tr_detailed: Bütün yarattıkları diliyle hamdedilen, her işi kusursuz olduğu için mutlak övgüyü hak eden.
description_en_detailed: Allah is worthy of all praise in His essence, names, attributes, actions, commands, and decrees.

meaning_tr_short: Her şeyin sayısını bilen, ihata eden.
description_ar_detailed: الذي أحاط بكل شيء علماً وعدداً, فلا يفوته مقدار ذرة.
description_tr_detailed: Evrendeki atomların, yıldızların, saç tellerinin ve her nefesin sayısını eksiksiz olarak hafızasında tutan.
description_en_detailed: Allah knows, counts, and encompasses all things completely. Nothing is absent from His knowledge, record, or reckoning.

description_ar_detailed: الذي أظهر المخلوقات من العدم أولاً وفق مشيئته.
description_tr_detailed: Kâinatı ve mahlukatı daha önce hiçbir benzeri yokken ilk defa varlık sahnesine çıkaran.
description_en_detailed: Allah originates creation without prior example, bringing things into existence by His will and power.

description_ar_detailed: الذي يعيد البرية أحياء بعد الموت كما بدأهم أول مرة.
description_tr_detailed: Varlıkları fani kıldıktan sonra, kıyamette onları ilk halleri gibi yeniden diriltip hayata döndüren.
description_en_detailed: Allah restores creation after death and returns all things as He wills by His perfect power.

description_ar_detailed: الذي يحيي النطف الميتة, ويعيد الأنفس إلى الأجساد يوم النشور.
description_tr_detailed: Cansız elementlere can vererek bitkileri, hayvanları ve insanları dirilten ebedi hayat bağışlayıcısı.
description_en_detailed: Allah gives life to whom and what He wills, both in the first creation and in resurrection after death.

description_ar_detailed: الذي يسلب ميزة الحياة من الأجساد عند انقضاء الآجال حكمًا.
description_tr_detailed: Canlıların tayin edilmiş ömürleri bitince biyolojik varlıklarını sonlandırarak onları ölüm uykusuna alan.
description_en_detailed: Allah causes death at the appointed time, taking souls by His decree and wisdom.

meaning_ar_short: الباقي الذي لا يموت، ذو الحياة المطلقة.
description_ar_detailed: المتصف بالحياة الدائمة المستمرة, الغني عن الفناء والحدوث.
description_tr_detailed: Hayatı bir ruha veya bedene bağlı olmayan, her şeye hayat veren, uyuklamayan ezeli diri.
description_en_detailed: Allah is the Ever-Living, whose life is perfect, eternal, and unlike the life of created beings.

meaning_ar_short: القائم بذاته والمقيم لكل ما سواه.
description_ar_detailed: الذي لا قوام للمخلوقات إلا بأمره ويدبر شؤون ممالكه بلا تعب.
description_tr_detailed: Varlığı kendinden olup, gökleri, yeri ve her mahluku ayakta tutan, düzeni koruyan yegane idareci.
description_en_detailed: Allah sustains Himself and all creation; He needs nothing, while everything depends entirely upon Him.

meaning_ar_short: الذي لا يعوزه شيء الغني المطلق.
meaning_tr_short: İstediğini anında bulan, hiçbir şeye muhtaç olmayan.
description_ar_detailed: الذي لا يفوته شيء، ولا يعجزه مطلوب، ولا يخفى عليه شيء.
description_tr_detailed: Kendisinden hiçbir mahluk kaçamayan, dilediğini dilediği an bulan, fakirlikten münezzeh zengin.
description_en_detailed: Allah is the Finder and Possessor; nothing is missing from Him, hidden from Him, or beyond His reach.

description_ar_detailed: المتصف بصفات الشرف العالية والتفضل العميم على البرية.
description_tr_detailed: Lütfu, cömertliği bol, şan ve şerefi her kelamın üstünde olan azametli yaratıcı.
description_en_detailed: Allah is noble and glorious, perfect in generosity, honor, majesty, and excellence.

meaning_ar_short: المنفرد الذي لا شريك له ولا قسيم.
description_ar_detailed: الواحد في ألوهيته وربوبيته فلا ند له في ملكه العظيم.
description_tr_detailed: Eşi, benzeri, dengi ve ortağı bulunmayan, bölünme kabul etmeyen yegane tek ilah.
description_en_detailed: Allah is One and unique in His essence, attributes, and actions. No partner, equal, rival, or counterpart exists with Him.

meaning_ar_short: المقصود في الحوائج الغني عن الخلق.
meaning_tr_short: Herkesin O'na muhtaç olduğu, Kendisi muhtaç olmayan.
meaning_en_short: The Eternal Refuge / The Self-Sufficient Master
description_ar_detailed: الذي يصمد إليه الخلائق في رغائبهم, السيد الذي كمل في سؤدده.
description_tr_detailed: Yemekten, içmekten münezzeh, tüm yaratıkların hacet kapısı olan, sarsılmaz, deliksiz mutlak bütünlük.
description_en_detailed: Allah is the Self-Sufficient Master to whom all creation turns in need, while He is free of every need and deficiency.

description_ar_detailed: الذي إن شاء فعل وإن شاء لم يفعل, قوته تامة كاملة.
description_tr_detailed: Hiçbir engelle karşılaşmadan, ölçülü ve planlı bir şekilde her şeyi yaratmaya muktedir olan.
description_en_detailed: Allah has full power over all possible things. Nothing can prevent what He wills or compel what He does not will.

meaning_tr_short: Kudreti her şeyi ezen, yaptırımı tam.
description_ar_detailed: الذي يظهر قوته البالغة في خلقه فلا يعاصيه أمر ولا يعجزه مراد.
description_tr_detailed: Kudretini mahlukat üzerinde dilediği gibi icra eden, tasarrufuna hiçbir kuvvetin karşı koyamadığı güç sahibi.
description_en_detailed: Allah is supremely powerful and fully able to execute His decree with complete authority and wisdom.

description_ar_detailed: الذي يقدم ما يشاء وفق حكمته الأزلية تقديراً شريفاً.
description_tr_detailed: Hikmeti gereği bazı varlıkları, peygamberleri veya olayları zaman ve şeref bakımından öne geçiren.
description_en_detailed: Allah brings forward whom and what He wills in rank, time, honor, or decree according to His wisdom.

meaning_ar_short: مؤخر وضع الشيء عن مكانه حكمة.
description_ar_detailed: الذي يؤخر عقوبة العصاة ممهلاً، أو يحط مرتبة المخالف خذلاناً.
description_tr_detailed: Düşmanlarını veya hak etmeyenleri liyakatine göre geride bırakan, cezaları erteleyen.
description_en_detailed: Allah delays or places later whom and what He wills, according to His wisdom, justice, mercy, and decree.

meaning_ar_short: الكائن قبل كل مخلوق بلا ابتداء.
description_ar_detailed: الذي لم يسبقه عدم، وكل ما سواه حادث بعد أن لم يكن.
description_tr_detailed: Varlığının öncesi bulunmayan, zaman zincirinin ilk halkasını var eden ezeli yaratıcı.
description_en_detailed: Allah is the First; nothing existed before Him, and His existence has no beginning.

meaning_ar_short: الباقي بعد فناء خلقه بلا انتهاء.
description_ar_detailed: الذي ليس بعده شيء, الباقي سرمداً بعد زوال الأكوان.
description_tr_detailed: Bütün evren fani olduktan sonra varlığı zeval bulmadan ebediyen kalacak olan tek zat.
description_en_detailed: Allah is the Last, remaining after all creation passes away. His existence has no end and is never touched by extinction.

description_ar_detailed: الذي ظهر فوق كل شيء علواً وقهراً, وعُرف بآياته الواضحات.
description_tr_detailed: Yarattığı harika eserlerle varlığı, birliği ve sıfatları apaçık ortada olan mutlak gerçek.
description_en_detailed: Allah is Manifest through His signs, power, and creation, while His essence remains beyond created comprehension.

meaning_tr_short: Zatının mahiyeti gizli olan, gözle görülmeyen.
description_ar_detailed: الذي ليس دونه شيء, المحتجب عن الرؤية في الدنيا حكمة.
description_tr_detailed: Dünyada duyu organlarıyla algılanamayan, akılların mahiyetini kuşatmaktan aciz olduğu gizli sır.
description_en_detailed: Allah is the Hidden, whose reality cannot be encompassed by human senses, imagination, or intellect, while He fully knows all hidden things.

description_ar_detailed: المنفرد بالتدبير المتصرف في الأكوان بالتربية والرعاية الحثيثة.
description_tr_detailed: Kâinat mülkünü idare eden, her an olaylara müdahale eden yegane genel yönetici.
description_en_detailed: Allah governs, protects, and manages the affairs of creation with perfect authority, wisdom, and care.

description_ar_detailed: المستعلي بجماله وجلاله عن أوهام المفترين وشبه الحوادث.
description_tr_detailed: Mahlukatın uydurduğu noksan sıfatlardan, sınırlardan ve her türlü beşeri kusurdan mutlak yüce olan.
description_en_detailed: Allah is exalted above every imperfection, limitation, partner, and created likeness; His greatness is beyond all ranks.

description_ar_detailed: الذي يحسن إلى عباده ويصلح أحوالهم ويتجاوز عن فرط سيئاتهم.
description_tr_detailed: Kullarına kolaylık dileyen, vaat ettiği bütün hayırları eksiksiz sunan mutlak iyilik kaynağı.
description_en_detailed: Allah is the source of all goodness, kindness, and beneficence, generous to His servants in this world and the next.

description_ar_detailed: الذي يعود بالمغفرة على من رجع إليه بالنوايا الصادقة الخالصة.
description_tr_detailed: Kul bin kere tövbe etse de pişmanlığını kabul buyurup onu tertemiz sayfa ile kucaklayan.
description_en_detailed: Allah accepts the repentance of His servants again and again, granting them return, forgiveness, and mercy.

meaning_tr_short: Suçluları hak ettikleri ceza ile yakalayan.
description_ar_detailed: الذي يقصم الجبابرة ويذيقهم وبيل أفعالهم نصرة للحق العادل.
description_tr_detailed: Zalimlerin, inkarcıların belini kırarak mazlumların intikamını alan, adaleti tam tecelli ettiren.
description_en_detailed: Allah takes just retribution from persistent wrongdoers, tyrants, and enemies of truth when His wisdom decrees.

description_ar_detailed: الذي يمحو السيئات ويتجاوز عن المعاصي تودداً ورحمة رحيبة.
description_tr_detailed: Günah kaydını amel defterinden büsbütün çıkararak kulu hiç suç işlememiş gibi aklayan.
description_en_detailed: Allah pardons sins completely, erasing blame and punishment for whom He wills by His grace.

description_ar_detailed: المتصف بغاية اللطف والرحمة المانعة من إنزال الشدائد بالمكلفين.
description_tr_detailed: Merhametin en yüksek zirvesini göstererek, kullarına taşıyamayacakları yükleri yüklemeyen, esirgeyen.
description_en_detailed: Allah is intensely kind and compassionate toward His servants, especially the believers, with mercy befitting His majesty.

meaning_ar_short: المتصرف في ملكه كيف يشاء بلا منازع.
description_ar_detailed: الذي لا يخرج عن سلطانه موجود, له الملك وله الحمد بيده الخير.
description_tr_detailed: Bütün varlık aleminin, mülkiyet sınırlarının yegane hakiki sahibi, dilediği gibi hüküm süren.
description_en_detailed: Allah is the absolute Owner of all dominion. Every kingdom, authority, possession, and rule belongs to Him alone in reality.

meaning_tr_short: Hem azamet hem de cömertlik sahibi.
meaning_en_short: The Lord of Majesty and Generosity
description_ar_detailed: الجامع بين صفات الجلال المهيب وبين صفات الجمال والإنعام الكريم.
description_tr_detailed: Kendisinden korkulmaya layık yücelikte, aynı zamanda kullarına ikramlar saçacak cömertlikte olan tek zat.
description_en_detailed: Allah is the Possessor of majesty and honor, combining perfect greatness with perfect generosity and noble grace.

description_ar_detailed: الذي يأخذ للمظلوم حقه من الظالم بغاية الانتصاف والرفق العادل.
description_tr_detailed: Mazlumların haklarını zalimlerden kuruşu kuruşuna alan, her işi birbirine denk ve dengeli kılan adil.
description_en_detailed: Allah is perfectly equitable, establishing justice among His servants and giving every right its due.

description_ar_detailed: الذي يجمع الأشباه والمتبائنات في الوجود, ربنا إنك جامع الناس ليوم لا ريب فيه.
description_tr_detailed: Ahiret meydanında tüm insanlığı toplayan, farklı özellikleri tek bir bünyede (bedende) cem eden.
description_en_detailed: Allah gathers creation for the Day of Judgment and brings together what He wills in this world and the next.

meaning_ar_short: المستغني عن كل ما سواه سبحانه.
description_ar_detailed: الذي لا يحتاج إلى شيء، وكل ما سواه محتاج إليه، الكامل في غناه وملكه الذاتي.
description_tr_detailed: Hiçbir yaratığa, ibadete veya mekâna muhtaç olmayan, her şeyin O'na muhtaç olduğu mutlak zengin.
description_en_detailed: Allah is free of all need and perfectly rich, while every created being is poor and dependent upon Him.

description_ar_detailed: الذي يسد فاقة المحتاجين ويغني من يشاء من خلقه بفضله العميم.
description_tr_detailed: Dilediği kullarına servetler ihsan eden, kalpleri kanaat nuruyla doyurup kimseye muhtaç etmeyen.
description_en_detailed: Allah enriches whom He wills with wealth, sufficiency, or contentment, and He alone is the giver of true independence from need of creation.

description_ar_detailed: الذي يحمي أولياءه ويمنع عنهم أسباب الهلاك والبلاء كلاءة.
description_tr_detailed: Kuluna zarar verecek şeylerin önünü kapatan, nimeti hak etmeyenden esirgeyen koruyucu bariyer.
description_en_detailed: Allah withholds what He wills and prevents harm or benefit as He wills, according to perfect wisdom and justice.

meaning_tr_short: Zarar veren, elem halk eden (hak edene).
meaning_en_short: The One Who Allows Harm / The Afflicter
description_ar_detailed: الذي يوصل الضر إلى من يشاء من العصاة حكمة مجازاة بالعدل.
description_tr_detailed: İsyankarlara sıkıntı, dert ve zarar ulaştıracak sebepleri yaratan mutlak yaptırım sahibi.
description_en_detailed: Allah creates benefit and harm according to His wisdom and justice. No harm occurs except by His permission and decree.

description_ar_detailed: المفيض بالخير والنفع على من يشاء من عباده تفضلاً وكرماً رحيباً.
description_tr_detailed: İnsanlığa şifa, hayır, bereket ve fayda sağlayacak her türlü unsuru bizzat halk eden.
description_en_detailed: Allah creates benefit and grants what is useful to whom He wills. No benefit reaches anyone except by His permission.

description_ar_detailed: الذي به أبصرت العقول, واهتدت البصائر, وظهرت الأكوان من ظلمة العدم.
description_tr_detailed: Gökleri ve yeri ışığıyla aydınlatan, karanlık kalpleri hidayet kandiliyle dirilten nurun kaynağı.
description_en_detailed: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth; He guides, illuminates, and makes truth clear to whom He wills.

description_ar_detailed: الذي يهدى قلوب أولياءه لمعرفته, ويهدي الحيوان لما يصلحه.
description_tr_detailed: Kullarının kalbini dosdoğru dine yönelten, canlılara yaşam yollarını ilham eden kılavuz.
description_en_detailed: Allah guides whom He wills to truth, faith, righteousness, and the path that leads to His pleasure.

meaning_ar_short: صانع الكون على غير مثال سابق.
description_ar_detailed: المبدع الذي لا يماثله شيء في حسن صنعه وإتقان بدائع خلقه.
description_tr_detailed: Kâinatı hayranlık uyandıracak bir sanat ve eşsizlikle, numunesiz var eden muazzam tasarımcı.
description_en_detailed: Allah originates creation with incomparable beauty, order, and wisdom, without prior example or model.

description_ar_detailed: الذي لا يلحق ذاته الشريفة عدم ولا زوال, الثابت سرمداً.
description_tr_detailed: Zaman akışından etkilenmeyen, her şey yok olduktan sonra da ebediyen kalacak olan tek varlık.
description_en_detailed: Allah is Everlasting; He remains forever and is never touched by extinction, decline, or end.

meaning_ar_short: الباقي بعد فناء الملاك المنتقل إليه الملك.
meaning_tr_short: Her şey yok olduktan sonra mülk Kendisine kalan.
description_ar_detailed: الذي ترجع إليه الأملاك بعد فناء العباد, وهو خير الوارثين.
description_tr_detailed: Geçici sahipleri öldükten sonra, kâinat mülkünün yegane hakiki sahibi olarak geriye kalan.
description_en_detailed: Allah is the Inheritor of all things. When creation passes away, all ownership and dominion remain with Him alone.

meaning_tr_short: Doğru yola kılavuzlayan, işleri kusursuz olan.
meaning_en_short: The Guide to the Right Path
description_ar_detailed: الذي لا يحتاج إلى توجيه, بل هو الهادي المرشد لكل صواب.
description_tr_detailed: Her işi tam bir isabet ve rüşt içinde olan, kullarını en doğru selamet yollarına sevk eden.
description_en_detailed: Allah guides rightly and directs all affairs to their proper ends with complete wisdom and sound judgment.

meaning_ar_short: الذي لا يعجل بالعقوبة صبراً ويمهل العصاة.
meaning_tr_short: Çok sabırlı olan, ceza vermede acele etmeyen.
description_ar_detailed: هو الذي لا يعاجل العصاة بالعقوبة بل يمهلهم ليتوبوا، ذو الأناة والصبر العظيم الذي لا يستفزه عصيان خلقه.
description_tr_detailed: Kendisine isyan edenleri anında cezalandırmaya gücü yettiği halde sabırla bekleyen, kullarına dönüş ve ıslah süresi tanıyan en sabırlı zat.
description_en_detailed: Allah is forbearing and patient, not hastening punishment though He has full power over all things.
